issue_description: It begins here! The critically acclaimed, fan-favorite storyline that rocked the X-Men Universe to its core is collected across four volumes! In a cracked-mirror world ruled by the genocidal mutant despot Apocalypse, only one hope remains: Magneto and his Astonishing X-Men! Collects X-MEN CHRONICLES #1 and #2, TALES FROM THE AGE OF APOCALYPSE: BY THE LIGHT, X-MAN #-1, X-MAN '96 ANNUAL, TALES FROM THE AGE OF APOCALYPSE: SINISTER BLOODLINES, and BLINK #1-4. 360 PGS./Marvel PSR ...$29.99
The truth about Annihilus is finally revealed in this stunning conclusion!

Her memory crippled by amnesia, Blink finds herself in the Negative Zone with many questions and no answers. The Negative Zone is a brutal place under the leadership of Blastaar. Can Blink survive and return home?
Blink has encountered a mysterious stranger in an even stranger land. Is he friend or foe?
Blink is now one of Magneto's X-Men. But being a team player was never her strong suit! Can Blink fall in line and be a good soldier or is she doomed to play the solo act?

The chronicle of the Marvel Universe is filled with mind-blowing events - and, in this book, we begin recording them in the Official Handbook of the Marvel Universe-style! Covering events from all eras of Marvel history! The Earth-shaking (The Great Cataclysm! World War II! House of M/M-Day!), the universe-changing (Operation: Galactic Storm! The Annihilation War! War of Kings!) and other significant moments in the lives of your favorite Marvel characters (the Richards/Storm Wedding! Lost in Space Time! Armor Wars!). Plus many more! Featuring new art by Gus Vazquez!
"Case of the Deep Sea Swindle!"" Namora and her crew protect a trove of gold bullion on a ship headed to Central America.

The first chapter in the life of Elsa Bloodstone, the world's cutest monster hunter, concludes here! Will Elsa do her father proud and embrace her family's legacy? Or will she even get the chance and be taken alive by a legion of monsters instead? The entity responsible for all of Elsa's woes is revealed here!

Young Elsa continues to learn just what it means to be a monster-hunting member of the Bloodstone family! But will the legacy she inherited from her father prove to be too dangerous to tackle? This issue has everything an aspiring monster-hunter could ever ask for, including an army of zombies and the return of the Living Mummy! Fans of Buffy the Vampire Slayer and Lara Croft: Tomb Raider won't want to miss this action-packed, tongue-in-cheek frightfest of a series!

Dracula strikes the new Bloodstone! Elsa Bloodstone has inherited her father’s powers, but will she follow in his footsteps and wind up dead, as well?! The brand new Bloodstone meets up with one of her father’s greatest enemies, the deadly Dracula! Will she be able to survive her first big test as the second-generation monster hunter? Or will Dracula put an end to her before she even gets a chance to prove herself? And what’s she going to do if her mom finds out what she’s been doing all night? With design help from Alex Ross, this four-issue series is a fun, light-hearted romp through the world of the supernatural!

Growing up was tough for Elsa Bloodstone. WASTELAND BLUES PART 2 When Cable collapses from hunger and exhaustion, the 7 year old girl he's been protecting faces the first challenge of her young life: saving her guardian from certain death.
WASTELAND BLUES PART 1 Deep in the future, Cable and the now seven-year-old mutant messiah find themselves in the middle of humanity's last stand. And humanity is losing!
WAITING FOR THE END OF THE WORLD CONCLUSION Cyclops. Emma, and Beast versus Bishop! Plus, hundreds of years in the future, Cable learns a terrible secret!

WAITING FOR THE END OF THE WORLD PART 3 Bishop has been captured by X-Force. And though Cyclops believes he's removed the last element of danger from the board, Bishop seems to think everything's going according to plan!

WAITING FOR THE END OF THE WORLD PART 2 Cable has taken the mutant messiah to a safe haven in the future only to discover that this timeline is marked for destruction by soldiers claiming to be the remnants of the U.S. government.
WAITING FOR THE END OF THE WORLD PART 1 It's Bishop versus X-Force in a battle that will have the X-Men's time-travelling former ally using all the tricks up his sleeve!
Cyclops must make a gametime decision after learning that Bishop is in hot pursuit of Cable and the last hope for mutankind!
WAR BABY CONCLUSION Cable versus Bishop in the war-torn streets of future Manhattan!

WAR BABY PART 4 Cable's old protà©gà©, Cannonball, has returned! In the future Sam Guthrie is one of the only remaining mutants and he'll do anything in his power to save Cable and the baby. It's Cannonball versus Bishop in a fight to the death!

WAR BABY PART 3 Cable has been injured and his timejumping device has malfunctioned. With dangerous men at every corner and Lucas Bishop still on the hunt for the baby, is there any place Cable can go to hide from the mayhem?

WAR BABY PART 2 Lucas Bishop has returned to eliminate the Mutant Messiah. Following Cable and the baby through the time stream, Bishop will stop at nothing until his twisted mission is complete. Even if that means taking Cable out as well!

WAR BABY PART 1 Cable has been tasked with safeguarding the Messiah of the mutant race! To protect the infant savior, Cable heads to the future. But hot on his trail is a relentless enemy who won't stop until blood is spilled!

“PAST FEARS” PART 5: BACK TO CABLE’S CHILDHOOD WITH REDD AND SLYM! Young CABLE faces his biggest fear: his own Techno-Organic virus! Guest-starring CYCLOPS & PHOENIX! Cable’s dark secret is finally revealed!
writer: Zac Thompson, Lonnie Nadler, Ed Brisson

issue_description: A RETURN TO CABLE'S X-FORCE DAYS! CABLE and the X-FORCE discover a horrifying secret inside STRYFE's secret base. Will Cable's past fears destroy his team? Guest-starring CANNONBALL, DOMINO, FERAL, BOOM-BOOM, and SHATTERSTAR! The original X-Force team returns!

CABLE RETURNS TO THE HELLFIRE HUNT! But will he be able to find sanctuary from a techno-organic villain from the far future? And will it have anything to do with these other Cables from different timelines? All this…plus, the return of Cable’s half brother, X-MAN!

It was only a couple of years ago that CABLE and a young HOPE were fleeing from BISHOP across a barren wasteland. But Bishop isn’t the only one hell-bent on hunting down the father and daughter duo! As fear consumes Cable, can he fend off both Bishop and a Techno-Organic monster to protect his daughter?
writer: Ed Brisson, Zac Thompson, Lonnie Nadler

issue_description: PAST FEARS BEGINS! Travel back to an untold tale in Cable’s past - when he was the leader of the New Mutants! What happened on this day that Cable hasn’t spoken of since? And how will this affect him today? From the new creative team of writing duo Zac Thompson and Lonnie Nadler (THE DREGS) and artist GERMAN PERALTA (THANOS)!

GIDEON: LAST OF THE EXTERNALS? Is the enemy of my enemy truly my friend? CABLE and the NEWER MUTANTS are about to find out. Can GIDEON kill the last of the EXTERNALS, becoming one of the most powerful beings in the MARVEL U? What's up with BLINK?! Whose side is she really on?

THE NEWER MUTANTS Part 4. EXTERNALS RISING! In the hunt for the EXTERNALS killer, a blast from CABLE’S past is revealed! Have Cable and the New Mutants walked straight into the killer’s trap? And what is BLINK’s role in all of this? Whose side is she really on?

THE NEWER MUTANTS Part 3! The Externals are dying one by one, but Cable’s assembled the strangest team of mutants from throughout time to put a stop to it…Longshot! Shatterstar! X-23! Armor! Blink! Doop! What makes them so uniquely qualified to answer the call? PLUS: THE RETURN OF GIDEON!

THE Newer mutants Part 2. Someone is killing off members of an ancient group of mutants called the Externals... But Cable’s crew of New Mutants are jumping through time to find the killer once and for all. And their investigation leads straight to the vampiric mistress Selene!

THE NEWER MUTANTS Part 1. The time-traveling mutant known as Cable has made it his one-man mission to preserve all of time itself. But when a disturbance in the timestream sends Cable back to the recent past, he’ll find a mutant killer he won’t be able to handle alone. Cable’s led teams of X-Men before and he’ll have to turn to some old allies and new friends to stop this deadly threat. Get ready for the newer New Mutants! PLUS: Includes 3 bonus MARVEL PRIMER PAGES! Story by Robbie Thompson and art by Mark Bagley!

THE SHOWDOWN YOU'VE BEEN WAITING FOR! It's CABLE vs. CONQUEST in a battle for time itself! The tables have turned, and with Cable's shocking reveal last issue, Conquest's lust for power turns desperate! But is that enough to stop his plans once and for all - or has time already run out?
At last - CABLE face-to-face with CONQUEST! But with an army assembled from throughout time, what chance does Cable have of surviving? A desperate play is all Cable has left -

A DANCE WITH DEATH! CABLE finds himself in ancient Mayan civilization facing down a futuristic death trap! But who will rear their head as an unlikely ally? Ancient history and future tech clash as the mystery behind CONQUEST'S deadly plan is at last revealed!

ONE STEP FORWARD — THREE CENTURIES BACK! CABLE follows his target back to feudal Japan…and is met with decidedly FUTURISTIC warriors! But WHOM exactly is Cable after, and what do they need in this time period? Jump into the timestream with CABLE and find out!

WALK SOFTLY...AND CARRY A BIG GUN! CABLE sees the mighty mutant return on a brand-new mission…with all of time in the balance! When Cable picks up the trail of a threat in the timestream, he sets off on a high-speed, history-spanning chase to save reality as we know it. From prehistory to modern day, whether it’s a six-gun duel at high noon or a high-tech sword fight in an ancient land, Cable is the only man who can keep history from unraveling!

And he's eager to exact his revenge on the man who left him broken and adrift in the timestream: CABLE. In the thrall of the Adversary, what havoc will Forge unleash upon Cable and X-Force? And in the wake of the devastation, can Cable come to terms with his drastically altered powers in time to save his daughter?

In the aftermath of X-Force's battle with the Uncanny Avengers, Cable's mutant powers have been drastically altered. What will this mean when the next cataclysmic threat comes knocking at X-Force's door?

Father and daughter are reunited as Cable's and Hope's separate missions converge! Cable has finally solved one of his most vexing problems - but a dozen more are still on the horizon! There's no rest for the weary as Hope, Cable, and the rest of X-Force converge to tackle an ominous new threat!

It's time for the final showdown: X-FORCE vs. THE UNCANNY AVENGERS! Can Hope save her adopted father from the Uncanny Avengers - and from himself? And in the wake of this tumultuous battle, what will be the future of Cable's X-Force?

It's a Summers Family Reunion when Cable and Havok come face to face! Can Cable convince his uncle that his cause is just? Elsewhere, Hope embarks upon a futuristic adventure - with an unexpected mentor!
Domino and Colossus team up for the heist of the century! But will their mounting feelings for one another keep them from pulling of their mission?

As tensions rise between X-Force and the Uncanny Avengers, Cable's precognitive visions grow increasingly relentless. X-Force must race against the clock to stop each terrible vision from coming true - but what will happen if they fail? In the world of X-Force, a minute can mean the difference between life and death.

Guest starring the Uncanny Avengers! Hope goes on the run, determined to help Cable whether he wants it or not...but the Uncanny Avengers have been keeping tabs on Hope and they're not about to let her get tangled up with Cable's band of fugitives!

Guest starring the Uncanny Avengers! Hope goes on the run, determined to help Cable whether he wants it or not...but the Uncanny Avengers have been keeping tabs on Hope and they're not about to let her get tangled up with Cable's band of fugitives!
Cable and his team go into space facing down an armada! Will this put them face-to-face with the UNCANNY AVENGERS, who are still hot in pursuit?
Cyclops comes face-to-face with his son Cable. Colossus isn't faring well in prison.
A new arc begins! Great jumping on point! Cable's team loses a member as Colossus goes to jail.
X-FORCE is officially on the run. Cable must face his daughter Hope, the savior of AVX. The Uncanny Avengers are hot on their trail!
Witness the massacre that makes Cable and X-Force criminals. They can't go back from here...
What has Colossus been up to post-AVX? What is wrong with his powers? And why are Cable and his team attacking a civilian company?

Cable is back! NOW! with a new X-Force at his side, he must tackle the threats that nobody else can know about. But just who are Cable's new recruits, and why is his team public enemy number one? Caught red-handed at the scene of a terrorist attack on a major American corporation whose CEO has expressed anti-mutant views, the X-Force is the run, with none other than the Uncanny Avengers in hot pursuit.

Marvel NOW! Caught red-handed at the scene of a terrorist attack on a major American corporation whose CEO has expressed anti-mutant views, the X-Force is the run, with none other than the Uncanny Avengers in hot pursuit.

Mister Sinister seeks to tap into Cable’s unlocked potential -- as the genetically engineered destroyer of Apocalypse! But will Cable fulfill his role as a vessel of death? And with Cable’s powers dwindling, will such a feat even be possible?

THE TIME IS NIGH! History’s favorite duo are back together, and just in time! When Deadpool is hired to protect a woman from time-hopping villains, it’s only a matter of time until he breaks the timestream. Fortunately, his old pal Cable has some experience with that. But dark secrets have put the client, and reality itself, in more danger than either of our heroes could have foreseen! David F. Walker, Paco Diaz, and a host of stellar guest artists take Cable and Deadpool on an adventure of epic proportions!

issue_description: The Askani'son investigates a S.H.I.E.L.D. clinic where the cyborg-esque Bastion is being held for observation. But Machine Man crashes the scene, and he seems to take a distinctly unfavorable view of the mutant Cable! The story continues in Machine Man/Bastion Annual (1998) #1!

It was 1990, the dawn of the most action-packed decade in comic-book history, and one man - one time-traveling gun-toting mutant cyborg mercenary - was there to lead the way! Opening with a one-man assault on the Mutant Liberation Front, Cable finds himself haunted by the failures of both past and future (not necessarily in that order), converging on him at once in the form of his doppelganger Stryfe! The secrets of the Six Pack and the quest of the Clan Chosen revealed! Featuring the X-Men, the New Mutants and the Warriors Three from THOR! Collecting NEW MUTANTS #87, CABLE: BLOOD & METAL #1-2 and CABLE #1-4.
Rated A ...$29.99
Cable and Kane set up a trap for Stryfe in Japan. But little do they know that Stryfe is doing exactly the same thing to them...
Delve into the history of Cable! Who is the man behind the mask of Stryfe?

THE BIG GUN IS BACK! It's a new era, in a new galaxy, that's under siege from a deadly new threat...but you can still rely on one man. Cable is locked, loaded and landing on the deadliest planet in X-history – to steal the ultimate weapon...and stop the LAST ANNIHILATION!
The Thing and Human Torch assist Cage in freeing himself of the Bogeyman!
This is Luke Cage as you’ve never seen him before – under possession by the Bogeyman! Unleashed and raving, Cage goes on a bender.
Will the unbreakable Cage be able to resist psychic persuasion while battling the Homeless Killer?
Details of Luke’s personal life are now public domain! Crusader comes in for the kill.
The Carnal Serpent awakens! Silver Sable, Terror and Cage do unholy battle.
Silver Sable and Terror guest-star! Cage joins the mercenaries-for-hire to maintain an ancient talisman.
The Tinkerer’s son is now safe thanks to Cage and Dakota North. But can the same be said for Coldfire, Luke’s recently transformed brother?
Cage agrees to an exchange of services for information on his father and brother. Dr. Karl Malus unleashes Coldfire!

Nothing will stop Cage in the pursuit of his brother and father…not even Hardcore! Luke’s closest relatives are being held hostage by this dangerous madman. Will Cage find the answers he needs before it’s too late?
Cage set-up by Troop? But why? Former allies reveal their true colors, as a gang named “Trash” takes the villainous spotlight. What does Trash want with Cage?
Two heavy-hitters, one single issue! The Hulk comes to town looking for the Rhino…and some answers. But will Luke Cage be able to talk sense into an animalistic Hulk? Not a chance.
Cage is in over his head when a client distorts the truth behind a case. Enter the Rhino, a villain as impenetrable as Cage!

Stories converge and explode in this jam-packed issue! Dakota North gets closer to finding Luke’s father…but is someone else tracking the same man? Meanwhile, Cage and the West Coast Avengers divert the disaster of the Power Man serum contaminating a local water supply!
Free from his bonds at a corrupt laboratory, Luke Cage hunts down Hardcore to have him answer for his misdeeds! A super-powered struggle in the mighty Marvel manner!

Luke Cage has an unwelcome blast from the past while imprisoned at a facility that’s experimenting with the Power Man serum! Innocent civilians are put through inhumane testing. Will a new generation of impenetrable Power Men and Women see the light of day? Not if Cage can help it!
Cage in Colorado! Picking up a job for Troop, Cage and Micky travel to the American West to locate a missing guardian. A sinister state trooper is much more than he seems.
Dakota North’s been kidnapped by members of The Untouchables, and only Cage and Punisher have the intel to save her. But will Cage’s worst shakedown of Hardcore be enough?
When The Punisher guest-stars, all bets are off! Two street-level crime fighters vs. The Untouchables, Hardcore’s personal taskforce. Will Cage and Castle bring the thunder? Yes, and then some.

Cage is hired as a bodyguard for a rapper who’s been a recent victim of racial crime. Luke Cage vs. Hammer, a terrorist group whose prime objective is violence against minorities. Cage unleashes his A-game.

Luke Cage takes the stage in his own ongoing series! Cage makes himself the ‘Hero for Hire’ for a Chicago newspaper. Cage busts the crime, while the journalists get a story! A perfect arrangement, until Luke encounters Hardcore, a dangerous mobster with an even more dangerous agenda.
It's the wrap-up, baby! Cage, Fist, Misty and a bevy of fellow travelers put the hurt on the big bad behind Luke's bad day! ? It's dynamite - only more explosive!
Trapped with Misty Knight, Iron Fist and a bevy of guest stars on the Island of No Return, Cage and his cohorts are forced to battle strange beasts who walk like men! It's outasight!
TRAPPED in the jungle a thousand miles from home, HUNTED by savage beasts that walk like men, Luke's got just one thing going for him: Ain't no cage that can hold Cage!

From the Award-Winning creator of Dexter's Laboratory, Samurai Jack and Hotel Transylvania! On the mean streets of Harlem, shoes are big, shirts are large, bottoms are belled and crime is rampant! But in the heart of the city, the world's hardest-working, smack-talking, chain-wearing super hero is on the street and on the case! And his rates are reasonable! He's CAGE! and he'll save your behind. Dig it!

This summer, Marvel Studios is bringing to life two of the AVENGERS in THOR and CAPTAIN AMERICA: THE FIRST AVENGER. But their adventures don't end on the silver screen. Pick up this 48-page book for two whole new stories starring Thor, Cap, and all your favorite characters from the films! Citadel of Spires: When Fandral - one of the Warriors Three - is taken captive, it's up to Thor, Sif and Loki to get him back... despite going up against one of the fiercest creatures in the nine realms! U-Base: When Hydra's U-Boats take out an Allied target, it's up to CAPTAIN AMERICA and his HOWLING COMMANDOS to strike back! The heroes sneak into a Hydra U-Base, but there they find that the tentacles in the Hydra logo might not be simply symbolic! From FRED VAN LENTE (Amazing Spider-Man, Incredible Hercules) and RON LIM (Silver Surfer, Infinity Gauntlet) comes a duo of Adventures from this summer's hottest heroes!

A battle 55 years in the making… Against the power of Baron Zemo!

Get ready for heart-stopping action and political intrigue aplenty as this classic partnership changes forever!

TWO AMERICAS PART 4 Captain America and the Falcon are reunited in Miami after the Falcon single-handedly faced down the super-powered Cap impersonator. Now Captain America must bring the "Anti-Cap" to justice!
TWO AMERICAS PART 3 Ordered to find and capture the Falcon, Captain America continues his search to uncover the true reason why the authorities want Cap's former partner in custody.

issue_description: March 1941. Assigned to safeguard President Roosevelt during a fishing trip in the Bahamas, the newly commissioned Cap endures his baptism under fire — while a German U-boat (carrying the Nazi super-soldier called Der Wunderkrieger (or Wonder Warrior) heads for the island chain’s capital! His mission: to kidnap England’s once-king, the Duke of Windsor, and sit him on the throne of a defeated Britain! But others happen to be in that part of the Atlantic as well — the once-bitter rivals the Sub-Mariner and the Human Torch!

Witness the cosmic conclusion of Captain America's most epic challenge yet! Marvel's man out of time has met his match in the omnipotent Michael Korvac, a freak of science from the future. Yesterday and tomorrow are on a collision course but will any of it matter in the shadow of GALACTUS THE WORLD DEVOURER?!!??

Bad enough Captain America is a hero from the 1940s trapped in today's world...now he's a FUGITIVE trapped in the 30th century! Can the mysterious Korvac figure out a way to get Cap back home, or is the Star-Spangled Avenger forever on the run from a future gone mad!?

You're Captain America: You're kinda strong & you've got a shield. They're the Guardians of the Galaxy: They're 30th century warriors with craaaazy-big powers. You both want the same thing. TIME FOR A FIGHT!!!!

Captain America: Proud member of the Avengers, but he's a man out of time, frozen for decades and unaccustomed to modern life. Can the Sentinel of Liberty learn to fight alongside heroes 60 years younger than him...and why does Cap feel a strange connection to the man named Korvac? Ben McCool (Choker) brings you an epic tale ten centuries in the making! 32 PGS./Rated A ...$2.99

In Earth's final hours, the Mighty Avengers come together one last time...but in the face of the end of everything, what help can they give? Guest-starring the latest and perhaps the greatest Mighty Avenger - YOU!

These are the stories of the end of the world, and of the people who faced the end together. Some of them wore costumes, and some of them didn't. Some had super-human powers, and all some had were each other. They were the Mighty Avengers. And this is what they did on the last day.

Final battle on the edge of infinity! Cap and the Mighty Avengers versus the creature from CORTEX! Featuring -- Spectrum unleashed! And the secrets of the Neutral Zone! What strange horror lurks... on The Outside?

Existential horror from beyond as CORTEX Incorporated drops the mask - and shows its true face! For one of the Mighty Avengers, the nightmare is starting all over again...Is this story even in continuity? Are YOU even in continuity? LOOK IN THE MIRROR - WHAT IF YOU'RE NOT?

Someone killed the man White Tiger hated most in the world - and now she has to bring that someone in! Meanwhile - something very, very strange is happening to CORTEX Incorporated...and Luke Cage is right in the middle of it.

In the aftermath of AXIS -- who will lead the Mighty Avengers? What will Captain America's role be? And can Luke's marriage survive? Meanwhile, Power Man and White Tiger hit the streets -- to solve the brutal murder...of Gideon Mace?

AXIS tie-in! You've dreaded it! You've dreamed of it! Now - it's here! THE AVENGERS/AVENGERS WAR! With Captain America and Iron Man bringing the full power of the Avengers against the Gem Theater, can our heroes possibly survive? Guest-starring Spider-Man! But which side is the wall-crawler on?

AXIS TIE-INS! Once, Luke Cage was a man of the people... a champion of the community... a hero for everyone who needed help. But there's a new Luke Cage in town... and the only one he's helping is himself! Plus: Captain America declares war - on the Mighty Avengers!

AXIS TIE-INS! They're the Avengers for the people, of the people - helping whoever needs it, however they need it. And together with Sam Wilson - the all-new Captain America - they are Mighty. Introducing: Flag-Smasher, the freedom-fighter gone mad! His goal: liberate Earth from the oppression of national rule! His target: The UN!
Cap gets a new job - and wait'll you see what it is!

In this issue: The Serpent Society is founded. Consisting of Sidewinder, Black Mamba, Death Adder, Princess Python, Cotton Mouth and Bush Master the venomous team targets Captain America and his comrades! Where's a snake charmer when you need one? Plus: An unexpected ally!
Madcap returns and Nomad must stop him in the wildest action-packed adventure this side of Yancy Street! Plus: the shocking truth about Nomad revealed!
Continuing from the pages of Secret Wars II, Captain America takes on the Armadillo, his most ferocious foe yet!
Who is Captain America? A better question is who is Steve Rogers? Introducing this issue: The Maniacal Menace of Madcap! Plus: A Dramatic look back at the Invaders of World War II.
Captain America and Captain Britain wage war against the Dark Mage Modred! But the question is will they survive?
Captain America is no stranger to weird visions or memories from his past! But when his visions lead him to England, what will the Star-Spangled Avenger find? Enter: Captain Britain!

Stane International has Cap's mighty shield! And Cap has vowed to get it back! But can even the legendary skill of the star-spangled Avenger overcome an opponent who wears armor created from the same mysterious metal as Cap's invincible shield?
Without his shield, is Captain America any match for Batroc's Brigade?
In this issue: Captain America goes up against Machete, a South American master of bladed weapons! Can Cap go toe-to-toe with this new enemy?

The Red Skull has been defeated! But Cap's not out of danger yet. With the combined efforts of Hank Pym and the Vision, the Avengers race against the clock to save Cap's life! But will their efforts prove successful when Mother Superior interrupts the de-aging process?
This issue: It's a battle to the death! Captain America versus the Red Skull!
His friends want to find him! His Foes want to kill him! This is Captain America's last stand!
At long last! The Shocking tale of the man behind the mask! The life and times of the Red Skull!

A defeated Captain America is subjected to torture and is forced to relive his worse memories over and again. Meanwhile, Sam, Bernie, and a catatonic Arnie devise a plan to escape from Mother Superior's trap. Its hard times for our heroes! Who will survive the Red Skull!

The hunt for Baron Zemo continues as Captain America and Nomad travel deeper into darkness! Plus: Cap's been poisoned with a serum that causing him to age rapidly. Will the Star-Spangled Avenger manage to defeat Mother Superior before it's too late!

Captain America's world comes crumbling down when Baron Zemo and Mother Superior put their plans in motion. With the lives of two loved at risk Captain America must race against the time to figure just what the Mother Superior and Baron Zemo are up to!
The fight with the Slayer continues! But things escalate when Mother Superior enters the fray! Plus: Who are the Sisters of Sin?

While out on a routine search for crime, Cap and Nomad are viciously attacked by a familiar face, Dave Cox. Now calling himself the Slayer, a bloodthirsty Dave vows to put an end to Captain America and all who stand beside him!

The spirit world has been unbalanced! Black Crow has another vision reminding him that as the spirit of old America, he must kill Captain America, the spirit of new America, to balance the scales. The Black Crow must do what must be done! Captain America must die!

Attack of the tumbler! In this issue: Captain America and the Tumbler join forces to investigate GLIC offices scandal. Will Captain America be able to help the Tumbler in his goals, and manage to get him to see the errors of his criminal ways?

While Cap and company go about their daily lives without a single crime in sight, Baron Zemo and Mother Superior join forces to bring about a terrible act of villainy our heroes will never see coming. Who will survive the shadows of the night?

As Cap rushes to warn the S.H.E.I.L.D. about Albert DeVoor's Operation: Purge, the world's heroes; the Avengers, the X-Men, and the Fantastic Four must rally together to save the world from its dystopian future!

Once in the future, Captain America joins the Redeemers and spring into action to stop Hellinger's plans to destroy the rest of the world's population! Can Cap save the world and change his future? Find out in the epic conclusion to Cap's most exciting adventure yet!

After an epic battle in the present time, 1983, Cap travels to the future with Deathlok to save the world! But when Deathlok tells Cap his world is a result of a mysterious happening in the 1983, Cap must act fast to stop it!

Traveling back in time from a dystopian future of 1991, Luther Manning arrives in the present day to find the lost Deathlok. Can Captain America aid him in finding the lost soldier before Manning draws any more attention to himself?
One of Cap's sharpest opponents, the Porcupine, returns! Plus: the shocking outcome of Patriot's losing battle with cancer!

It seems Cap's troubles just keep piling up. With Dum Dum Dugan hospitalized, Jeffrey Mace succumbing to his battle with cancer, and extreme violence in the city, will Cap be able to hold himself together before going mad?
After a failed attempt to defeat Viper, Cap, Dugan, Nomad, and Gail Runciter find themselves facing certain death when Viper plots to release a deadly virus into the population!

After donning the Nomad costume, Jack Monroe and Dum Dum Dugan rush to Illinois to recue Captain America and Gail Runciter and foil the Viper's sinister plot! Will the two make a good team and save the day? Find out when Cap and company face Viper!

After a night out, Rogers and Bernie are being followed home by Jack Monroe, the 1950's Bucky. Meanwhile, Spider-Woman tracks Viper to an abandoned warehouse only fall prey to a trap. Does Bucky's reappearance have anything to do with Viper's plans?
The murderous Scarecrow has targeted CUA members. In order to protect the remaining members Captain America joins their campaign!

Steve Rogers and Bernie Rosenthal are on a date when they are suddenly interrupted by a mad Captain America! How can Captain America be fighting Steve Rogers when he is Steve Rogers? Which one is the real Steve Rogers?

The battle with Baron Zemo continues when Captain America manages to rescue Arnie Roth, but just when they think the fight is over, Baron Zemo send his hordes of mutates after them? Will Captain America manage to escape Baron Zemo's clutches?
In a shadow-shrouded castle somewhere in Mexico, Captain America must face his past-and himself when he becomes Baron Zemo's prisoner!

Bernie Rosenthal comes to the sudden realization that Captain America is in fact Steve Rogers. But before they can discuss anything, Captain America is whisked away to aid an old childhood friend, when he is abducted by a man called, Baron Zemo!
America is a land free from tyranny, but when a group of Neo Nazi rally together will Captain America uphold the First Amendment? Or will he let his fears of another world war get the better of him?
Baron Strucker is back with a vengeance and he wants to kill a commando! Can Captain America solve Baron Strucker's motives before it's too late? Find out when a hero dies!
It's Captain America and the Howling Cammandos! What more can we say, but... WA-HOOO!
When Sam Wilson's nephew is shot, trying to prevent a robbery, Cap and Falc team up to solve the sudden upsurge of criminal activity in Harlem! But things get weirder when the Vermin enters the fray.
Cap enters into the "rasslin'" ring in a challenge match against the mystery man known as "X". Cap's got this in the bag... Right?
Cap finds himself in a messy situation when he comes to the aid of an old friend. Can Cap protect his friend? And at what cost? Don't miss out as Captain America faces the Purple Fibered Monster!

It's Team America in this all-new action-packed issue! Captain America teams up with the new motorcycle stunt performers, Team America, to stop the Mad Thinker from kidnapping the world's Nobel Peace Prize Winners!

Kyle Richmond, Gargoyle, Valkyrie and Hellcat of the Defenders have been captured by August Masters and his minions who have been manipulating psychics for his own goals. Can Cap save the day? Or will August Master conquer all?

When Captain America addresses a high school assembly, a student ridicules Cap's "false American Dream and tries to assassinate him. Has the nation lost faith in the Sentinel of Liberty? Will Cap America turn a blind eye to cracks in our nation?

The fight against the Sultan continues! When the heroes find themselves overwhelmed by the Sultan's evil forces, it's up to Peter Parker to use his genius intellect to save the world! Hey, I thought Cap was the star of this comic book!

When Captain America is abducted, it's up to Spider-Man and Nick Fury to save him! But when the super villain is revealed to be none other than the Sultan, things take an ugly turn for the worse. Don't miss this thrilling issue when Spider-Man teams up with S.H.I.E.L.D.!
Captain America and Falcon must team up against a horde of Nazi, to save the X-Men, the world's strangest super heroes!
Cap's battle with Ameridriod continues! During his struggle with the android, it is revealed that one of Cap's most villainous foes is behind it all. It's the return of the Red Skull!
He's twice as big and twice as much trouble! Don't miss this issue as Captain America takes on the power-mad Ameridroid!
When Captain America makes a trip to California, he's greeted by the resident hero, Nomad! Can Cap and Nomad team up together to stop the rising crime in the City of Angels?
What happens when the Sentinel of Liberty finds himself behind bars? You don't want to miss this issue!

The Star-Spangled Avenger is sent to go find the son of Ray Coulson, who has recently joined a biker gang. It is here that Captain America learns that Doc Ock has been following him. Can Cap defeat the Doc Ock and the gang without his shield?
While out on a date with the lovely Bernie Rosenthal, an explosion rocks the town, and Steve must spring into action! But when it's clear he's in over his an unlikely hero comes to his rescue!

While Captain America journeys through England, Bruce Banner, the Hulk's smart half is kidnapped. Does Banner's disappearance have anything to do with Captain America's investigation of the Matrix Eight?
writer: Mike W. Barr, Jim Shooter - Duplicate

issue_description: Memories of past adventures bring Captain America to England's Greymoor Castle. Once there, Captain America must confront the ghosts of his past as he teams up with the mysterious Cedric Rawlings to stop villainous Druid!
It's the 40th anniversary of Captain America! Join Cap and his comrades down memory lane, and witness the legend that is Captain America!
Captain America faces a vampiric foe known as Baron Blood. Can the Sentinel of Liberty overcome his mesmerizing powers before Baron Blood sinks his fangs into him?
When a serial killer runs loose in northern London, Captain America must confront a monster from his past.
Captain America battles both Batrok and Mr. Hyde in this blockbuster issue! Don't miss out!
Captain America reflects over his many years as America's living legend! Witness the shocking ending to The Mercenary and the Madman! The dream begins now!
He may be the nation's champion, but is Captain America fit to be its leader? Find out when Captain America runs for President!

Cap's battle with Dragon Man continues! Once Captain America starts to gain the upper hand on Dragon Man, things take a turn for the worse when he finds himself going up against the Thing, Magneto, and Spider-Man?
He's back! Dragon Man is on the loose once again and that means bad news for Cap, as he finds himself literally in the beast's clutches.

Baron Strucker strikes! Captain America and Dum Dum Dugan team up to stop the evil super villain before he blows Brooklyn right off the map! Will they succeed? Or will this be Cap's biggest failure? Plus: a startling secret of Captain America revealed.
He was just a guy named Joe until society stole his son. Now, he's back, and he may just be Caps deadliest foe yet!
When a survivor of the Holocaust seeks revenge on a former Nazi, will Captain America be able to stop her from making the biggest mistake of her life? Don't miss the Calypso connection!
More machine than man, it shambles forward slowly, hesitantly, as if unwilling to step from the dark shadows of the lab that gave it life! Enter a monster gone berserk, Adonis!

The Shield Slinger is targeted when the Adonis, Eric Cameron, returns. With a sinister plan to kill Steve Rogers to gain Life Eternal, Adonis will give the Star-Spangled Soldier the fight of his life!

Captain America versus the world! There's a new villain in town and his name is the Manipulator! Captain America will have to confront the world to stop this villain. Read, to witness the shocking ending!

In his efforts to stop organized crime in Brooklyn, Captain America comes across his morally grey counterpart, the Punisher. Is Steve Rogers and Frank Castle alike in more ways than one? Find out in "Fear Grows in Brooklyn"!

Even America's Champion can deny the enjoyment of a good old fashion brawl! Captain America finds himself going up against the likes of the Big Thunder and the Coney Island Cruisers! Find out and see who ends up on top!

It's a battle to the death as Captain America face off with the Widowmaker! Will Captain America survive what comes next? Or will the Widowmaker and his partner in crime, Stephen Tuval outwit the Super-Soldier?
It's a modern day fairytale as Captain America travels to the top of the world, to rescue a damsel in distress. But Cap will learn soon that this is no ordinary damsel! Plus: beware the Hawk Riders!

After learning the tragic fate of Sharon Carter, Captain America turns away from the life of heroics. But before he is anything else, he is a soldier, and when Nick Fury asks for his help on a special mission, Captain America's accepts proudly!
Captain America and Daredevil face off with Doctor Fautus, but after finally learning the true identity of the Grand Director, can Cap bring himself to put an end to all this madness?
Cap along with Daredevil leap into action to save the captive Peggy Carter. Will Cap's foolhardiness be the death of him? Find out as Cap takes flight into fear!

It's a race against the clock as Cap finds himself in the middle of a war between the National Force and Morgan's gang. Will the Star-Spangled Soldier be able to stop the two factions before they destroy the city? Plus: Is this the end for Sharon Carter?

The world of Captain America is turned upside down when the Sentinel of Liberty is brainwashed and turned against his comrades. Can Daredevil, the man without fear, bring Cap back before he reaches the point of no return? Find out and see!
Captain America finds himself going up a new kind of evil, when he and Peggy Carter set out to stop the Grand Director. Can Captain America triumph? Or will he get an old friend killed?

Captain America sets out to find the Falcon once more, this time in his hometown, Harlem. But instead of finding his comrade, Cap finds the entire city hypnotized by the Grand Director, who has brought hatred, racism, and violence to New York City!
Captain America teams up with Marvel Man and Vamp to infiltrate the Alcatraz Corporation, but things go haywire when Bruce Banner is abducted! Plus: Who's working with Kligger?
Captain America sets out to find the Falcon, but his journey soon becomes complicated when a mysterious corporation is revealed! Will Cap ever find Sam Wilson?
Captain America and the Constrictor! Can Cap defeat this new villain? Plus: Where's Sam Wilson, the Falcon?

The Red Skull has taken full control over the S.H.I.E.L.D. helicarrier. With Captain America on the run from a horde of Red Skulls and Col. Nick Fury facing certain death, it looks like this may be the end for America greatest soldiers!

Desperate to prove he's more than what the Super Soldier serum made him, Captain America faces off against Impact 739, an S.H.I.E.L.D. training robot. But things take a turn for the worse when the Red Skull appears! Can Cap survive the Red Skull's ambush?
This issue-A Captain America you've never seen before! The secret of Captain America's other life finally revealed!

After embarking on one of his missions, Captain America is found floating in a river, with no memory of what happened to him the night before! Can Cap gather his memories in time to complete his mission? Find out as it's a race against the clock to stop the Madbomb!
Captain America grows suspicious of Veda's alliance to S.H.I.E.L.D. But is it too late when the monstrosity known as Animus appears?

On his quest to find out more about his past, Steve Rogers sets out to Washington D.C. But to his surprise, Cap finds himself in an all-out battle to the death with his hero! Plus: Veda isn't who she claims to be.
In the seeds of his past, Steve Rogers finds a perilous present! Watch Cap takes on the world in the Hour of the Hero!
writer: Scott Edelman, David Anthony Kraft, Steve Gerber

issue_description: The past adventures of Captain America continue! With villains running amuck, Steve Rogers and Bucky Barnes scramble to stop the combined forces of Baron Zemo, Lyle Dekker, and the Red Skull!
Captain America, the hero! Captain America, the Sentinel of Liberty! Captain America, the movie star?

It's never an easy day for America's Champion. Steve Rogers may be a super hero, but that doesn't exempt him from ordinary people problems. Can Cap find a balance between Sharon Carter and the new Veda? Plus: what does General Lyle Dekker know that Captain America Doesn't? Find out in One Day in Newfoundland!

Nick Fury has some new recruits that need some breaking-in. Can Cap and Falc train the next generation of S.H.I.E.L.D. Agents? How will the veteran super heroes pass on the torch! Find out in this awesome new issue!
Blazing battle with a surprising finish! Captain America versus the Human Torch!
Captain America is the people's champion. But that's only the image, who is Captain America, really? Better question: "Who is Steve Rogers?"
Cap and Falcon take on the Night Flyer, who has in his use, a dangerous force called "the Power."
In a SHIELD-run hospital, a heavily bandaged man known only as the Defector is attacked by Night Flyer. Still wounded from his last battle, Cap must step in to save the mysterious man.
As the Red Skull's deteriorating headquarters crumbles around them, Sharon Carter and a blinded Cap must find a way to escape before it's too late.
Captain America battles tooth and nail against the entity called Nazi X!
Now that Captain America is trapped, the next step in Red Skull's plan can begin!
Arnim Zola has captured Cap through the use of his abominable creation known as the Doughboy!
Captain America is on the hunt for a village along the Rio De Muerte when he is attacked by a vicious waterborne monster!
After his plane crashes in the jungle, Cap is hunted by the Swine!
Captain America and the Falcon are trapped in the domain of the Swine!
Agron has broken loose! It's up to Captain America and Falcon to contain his dangerous energy-form to save the day!
While trying to restore Falcon's memories, Cap crosses paths with a beastly humanoid known as Agron. How can Captain America take down a "man" who grows stronger and larger with each step?
Cap and Falcon take on Brother Inquisitor, Brother Wonderful, and the Night People on in another dimension!
Cap is on the hunt for the missing Falcon. Little does he know that his friend and ally has been indoctrinated into the cult of the Night People!
Captain America and the Falcon are in the grip of the grotesque and strange Night People!
SPECIAL BICENTENNIAL ISSUE! On the 200th anniversary of the United Stated America will die! And only Cap can save it!
During a moment away from the costumed ball at his estate, William Taurey activates Big Daddy a.k.a Madbomb!
Captain America, Falcon, and General Fist have finally located the Madbomb assembly plant. But the Madbomb has been moved! Can the trio find it before it goes off?
Captain America takes on a whole swath of murderous warriors underground!
Captain America and the Falcon find themselves in a middle of the Kill-Derby! It's a battle to the death for these gladiators! The rules: Anything goes! Don't miss out on the Kill-Derby games!

If Captain America is for the people, what happens when the people turn against him? Can Cap and Falc keep the peace? Or will they fail, costing them everything they hold dear? The savage world of 1984 is here!
Cataclysmic Kirby action in the mind-bogeling Marvel manner! See Cap and the Falcon battle for their lives against the Trojan Horde!
King Kirby is back to bring you an all new action-packed issue! "Madbomb" can it really destroy the earth? Can Cap and Falc save the world? Read to find out!
Its fight or flight for the Star-Spangled Soldier, literally. Can Captain America manage to survive the slaughter in the sky?
The Falcon has a hit on him. Can the dynamic duo manage to defeat the murderous Stilt Man before he can complete his mission? Find out in the trial of the Falcon!
Get ready for an all-action issue! Cap and the Falcon take on S.H.E.I.L.D., Night Shade, and the deadliest robot assassin of all time!
Arena for a fallen hero! Unless Captain America can defeat an army of super-villains, the Falcon fights no more!
Battle after battle, Captain America faces the never ending army of villainy! With Sam Wilson out of commission, can Steve Rogers face the Alchemoid alone?
Captain America finds himself overwhelmed by the Demon-Druid's death trap! Can Steve Rogers survive the Murder-Maze! Find out in this awesome new issue!
Revealed at last! The true facts behind the origin of the Falcon! Will this be the end of the Dynamic Duo?
With Captain America hopelessly outnumbered, will the Red Skull finally triumph? Prepare for an unbelievable ending!
The Red Skull is back to exact revenge on Captain America once again! But will there be an innocent lost in their never ending war of good versus evil?
The death of a hero! Can Steve Rogers move on from his old life? Or will the death of a comrade suck him back into the world of Captain America!
See the man called Nomad trapped in an inferno! Plus, the end of the sinister Serpent Squad!
With Steve Rogers as the Nomad, will another don the Captain America costume? Find out the secret identity of the new Captain America!
The end of Captain America! The awesome origin of Steve Rogers' new identity! Look out evil wrong-doers! Here comes the Nomad!
Captain America may be the champion of liberty, but is Steve Rogers a match for the Golden Archer?
Perhaps the most action-packed Cap thriller of them all! Read, as the world ask, "Where is Captain America!"
Captain America is no more, and the Falcon must face the raw power of Lucifer! Will this be Sam Wilson's finest hour? Or will this be his day of doom? Find out now as the Falcon stand alone!
Steve Rogers has had enough! The Star-Spangled Soldier renounces his Captain America identity... for good!
Cap and the Falcon manage to defeat the Secret Empire, but can they survive the likes of the deadiest Man-Menace of all? Find out in this action-packed issue!
Can Captain America and the Falcon survive their showdown with the Secret Empire?
Make way for the Marvel Age of Comics! Captain America, the Falcon, and the X-Men in deadly combat with the Nick Fury and his hell-raising Agents of Shield!
Captain America and the Falcon fall prey to the deafening screams of the Banshee!

Cap's in jail and accused of murder! He's been set up by the malicious committee to regain America's principles and its super-figurehead, Moonstone-and Cap's unable to prove his innocence! Plus, the Falcon gets new wings!
The Star-Spangled Avenger finds himself on the other side of the law in this issue! Find out why Captain America is a wanted criminal!
Captain America may be a trained gymnast, but he's no match for the Tumbler! Plus, find out why the Falcon and the Black Panther meet in secrecy when a legend dies!
Who is the Phoenix? You'll gasp when you learn his startling secret identity!
This is it! The final fatal Showdown with the Yellow Claw!
Cap, Fury, and the Falcon face off with the seemingly never ending horde of zombies! Who will survive the night of the lurking dead?
After defeating Deadly Nightshade, Queen of the Werewolves, the Star-Spangled Avengers uncovers the identity of Nightshade's hidden leader-The Yellow Cat!
Cap is at the mercy of Nightshade and her werewolf army!
Cap and the Falcon throw down with the Serpent Squad!
Captain America is thrown into a hallucinatory prison that he cannot escape!
Who is Dr. Faustus' prisoner and why is Captain America so shocked?!
Captain America and the Falcon battle Solarr!
Still reeling from the Viper's poison, Steve Rogers has been arrested by the NYPD!
It's Round 2 for the Falcon, and the Viper! This time, the antidote for the Viper's poison is a swift kick to the face!
In a harrowing encounter with the Viper both Captain America and the Falcon are poisoned! Will they be able to rid themselves of the Viper's toxin in time?
This one has the Falcon seeing double: Captain America takes on the Captain America from the 1950s!
Prepare for the never-before-see secret origin of Captain America!
The Avengers want Captain America, dead or alive!
Captain America takes on...Nick Fury?!
Captain America and the Falcon in: Terror in the Night! Mr. Hyde and Scorpion continue the assault on our heroes!
Mr. Hyde strikes again! The Scorpion hangs loose! Get ready for panic on Park Avenue!
Captain America and the Falcon are trapped in the Bottles of Death by the new, super-powerful Stranger!
Captain American and the Falcon take on Batroc's Brigade!

Battling the Kingpin in the Las Vegas suite of mysterious industrialist Harold Howard, the Red, White, and Blue Avengers and the Fighting Falcon are suddenly stunned by the senses-shattering sight of the Red Skull!

While Cap and the SHIELD Femme Force battle to destroy the forces of Hydra in an underground fortress near Las Vegas, a sinister figure watches the melee and prepares to press the button which will destroy the combatants on both sides...

Last issue, Steve Rogers' world was shaken to the core. Will the Star Spangled Avenger finally put an end to HYDRA? Or will anger consume him in his pursuit for revenge? Plus, find out who's been pulling the strings all along!

It's the most cataclysmic climax of all when Cap and the Femme Force face off with HYDRA! But will they prevail over the forces of evil? Or will Steve Rogers lose the love of his life? Find out in this shocking issue!
Captain America and the Falcon split up! Introducing: the fantabulous Femme-Force! Plus, HYDRA, the most sinister of all insurrectionist organization are on the rise!
It can't be! It isn't possible! Not Him! Not the Red Skull!

Captain America and the Falcon join forces with Nick Fury and Agent 13 in a final attempt to stop the Grey Gargoyle! Will their efforts prove to be successful? Or will the Grey Gargoyle destroy all they've sworn to protect?Don't miss this unbelievably ending!

Elementary X is the most destructive substance known to man! Will Captain America be able to find and defeat the Grey Gargoyle before he gets to use it to destroy the world? Or will he lose his most trusted friends to the Gargoyle's stony grasp

Cap and the Falcon find themselves going toe-to-toe with the Grey Gargoyle, a villain with the power to turn people into stone. Will Captain America and the Falcon be able to defeat this demon of the night?
The dynamic duo is brought to an halt when Steve Rogers hangs up his winged cowl for the uniform of a police officer, the Falcon is left to fight alone!
Cap and Falcon face off against...Spider-Man?!
Wanting to prove himself worthy of being Captain America's partner, Falcon pursues the perceived menace of Spider-Ma
When Cap and a giant gorilla, are trapped in the underground lair of the Mole Man, it's up to the Falcon to rescue him!
Get ready for Captain America and the Falcon to fight their most epic battle yet? Against a gorilla? Don't miss Captain America and Falcon as they take on a new kind of criminal!
Captain America gets a new partner and co-star! Don't miss out on Cap's most exciting adventures yet!

Say, "hello," to M.O.D.O.K.'S little friend, Bulldozer Man! Rogers and Wilson find themselves going up against M.O.D.O.K.'S latest invention, tearing through the streets of Harlem. Can Captain America and Falcon stop him before there's nothing left to save?

The shocking truth about Bucky Barnes is revealed! Is he here to stay? Or is he merely just a pawn in M.O.D.O.K.'S grand scheme? Will the Sentinel of Liberty finally let go of his old comrade? Find out in this shocking issue!

The Hood decides that the best way to defeat Captain America is through his past. Plotting to use Bucky Barnes lookalike, The Hood plans to kill Captain America. Will the Hood's sinister plan work? Or will Cap come to terms with his past and win?

After stopping a student riot, Rogers is asked to make a PSA conference to condemn the students for rioting. When things don't go as planned, The Hood, Baron Strucker in disguise, hires the Batroc's Brigade to take him out. Is this Cap's last speech?

Steve Rogers is still enjoying his trip across the country. But things take a turn for the worse when the Red Skull makes a surprise return to exact his revenge! Will Rogers manage to defeat the red menace and avoid an international crisis?

Taking a break from his never ending battle against villainy, Captain America hits the open-road. But when he's mistaken for a member of the Satan's Angels gang, Captain America finds himself on the other side of crime.

Things are looking grim for the Sentinel of Liberty. First, he's betrayed by Sharon Carter, and then accused of treachery against S.H.I.E.L.D. Will Steve manage to break this chain of bad luck? Or will he lose yet another friend?

Captain America learns that his one-time sidekick, Falcon, is a wanted criminal. Believing this to be false, Captain America sets out to clear the Falcon's good name. But can Captain America overcome the heavy streets of Harlem?

Devastated by the apparent betrayal of Sharon Carter, Captain America dives into a rescue mission to save the famous Dr. Robert Hoskin from the Mandarin. Can the Sentinel of Liberty get over his heartbreak long enough to save the good doctor?
M.O.D.O.K. will go to any length to destroy Captain America. Captain America will do anything to keep justice and peace. Find out to see who will win in this action packed issue!

While Captain America contemplates his next move with Sharon Carter, Suprema, an ambitious criminal tries to take over the criminal underworld. Can Captain America fight crime and conquer love at the same time? Or will he lose everything instead?

Captain America is once more brooding over his lot in life, wondering if he is doomed to live as a symbol of the American dream as Captain America, or if he can find a normal life as Steve Rogers. What path will the Super Soldier choose?

Silas X. Cragg is obsessed with Captain America. Seeing him everywhere he turns, the mad scientist wish to create an even stronger, more fearsome super soldier to destroy the Star-Spangled Avenger. But who is worthy of such a task?
Following his battle with the Red Skull, Captain America returns to the U.S. to patch things up with Sharon Carter. However, Nick Fury has other plans for the Sentinel of Liberty.

Captain America and Falcon prepare for their final showdown with the Red Skull. But with the Cosmic Cube in the Red Skull's clutches it seems all hope is lost. Plus, M.O.D.O.K.'s shocking return from the dead!

With the help of Sam Wilson, the Falcon, Steve Rogers defeats the murderous Exiles. But the Red Skull isn't done yet! Fed up with constant rejection, Rick Jones decides to leave the world of the Avengers and try to find his own way.

With Captain America away, the Red Skull will play. Captain America is stranded on Exile Island with the Red Skull's murderous minions, while the red-faced devil ruins his reputation with the world. Will the Red Skull finally win?

As the ultimate revenge, the Red Skull has used the Cosmic Cube to swap bodies with the Star-Spangled Avenger. Can Steve Rogers convince his fellow Avengers he's not the Red Skull, the crazed genocidal maniac?

With the Cosmic Cube back in his grasp, the Red Skull plans to take over the world. But will Captain America fight? Or will he leave the fate of the world in the hands of the next generation of super heroes?
Cap teams up with Rick Jones and Sharon Carter to take down the AIM robot called the Walking Stiletto!
While the members of Hydra celebrate the death of Captain America, Madame Hydra recounts her early years in Europe.
Once the smoke clears from Cap's battle with Hyrdra, his bullet-ridden uniform is pulled out of the water. Is Captain America dead?
Nearly all of Jim Steranko's covers could make this list, but it's the timelessness of this Cap cover that shines on.
When a skirmish between the Hulk and Captain America leaves Rick Jones injured, Cap is left with a choice: bring Jones to safety or pursue the Jade Giant?
The origin of Captain America!
Sharon Carter is the prisoner of the Trapster! Will the machinations of the Trapster be too much for Captain America to overcome?
Captain America's mind is under attack by one of his most nefarious enemies...his shrink? It's a battle for sanity when Cap goes toe to toe with Dr. Faustus.
