As reporter Jackie McGee tries to put together the pieces, Banner treads a lonely path from town to town - unearthing murder, mystery and tragedy as he goes. And what Banner discovers, the Hulk smashes! The critically acclaimed reinvention of one of Marvel's biggest icons is re-presented in Director's Cut form, complete with Joe Bennett's savage pencils and more incredible bonus features!

The horror has a name - and now it is unleashed in full graphic detail! You'd never notice the man. He doesn't like to be noticed. He's quiet. Calm. Never complains. If someone were to walk up and shoot him in the head...all he'd do is die. Until night falls. And someone else gets up again. The man's name is Banner. The horror is the Immortal Hulk. And trouble has a way of finding them both! The critically acclaimed reinvention of one of Marvel's biggest icons is re-presented in Director's Cut form, complete with Joe Bennett's savage pencils and more incredible bonus features!

ONE CREATOR – ONE HULK – ONE SUPERSTAR STORY! Declan Shalvey writes and draws an IMMORTAL HULK tale that gets to the heart of gamma! Every morning, Bruce Banner wakes up in a new place. The Hulk is trying to tell him something — but Bruce has had enough of his green-veined alters. When a new gamma-powered villain shows up in a small New Mexico town, Bruce is forced to confront the source of his anger…and it’s not what you expect. Don’t miss an extraordinary tale from one of the industry’s top talents!

THE HULK FINDS A NEW HOST: THE AMAZING SPIDER-MAN! When Bruce Banner wakes up in the middle of the night without the Hulk, he thinks he’s finally free. But the Hulk is immortal — and the night’s not over yet. If you thought he was dangerous in the body of mild-mannered Bruce Banner, wait till you see him now. Peter Parker is a man with the proportional strength and agility of a spider, capable of lifting trains on his bad days. And he’s about to get a big, green power-up — with a temper to match.

“THE BEST DEFENSE” STARTS HERE! Stephen Strange is dead. A charred skeleton in an abandoned barn on the edge of a deserted town. Bruce Banner wants to know why. And he won’t stop until he has the truth in his hands…with or without THE IMMORTAL HULK.

TWO OF COMICS’ MOST IMAGINATIVE TALENTS UNITE FOR A HULK TALE LIKE NONE OTHER! There’s a monster raging in America’s heartland – and it’s not the Hulk. When a young girl goes missing on a Kansas farm, Bruce Banner gets the itch – the one that tells him gamma is on the loose. But this town doesn’t take kindly to strangers – especially the big, green, violent kind. Can the Hulk save a child before it’s too late, or is he about to take the blame for another massacre?

AL EWING AND ALEX PAKNADEL INTRODUCE THE ORIGINAL HULK! Ten thousand years ago, something green and glowing comes to poison the ancient ground of the Fertile Crescent — and the hearts of its people. One boy is left to bear the consequences — and, for the first time...to open THE GREEN DOOR. Plus: Bruce Banner faces a challenge unlike any he’s seen before as writer David Vaughan makes his Marvel debut!

Hulk and Qnax continue their search for the Ultimate Machine, and come face to face with the most mysterious character in all of Marvel - the Watcher! Plus, the shocking secrets of Betty Ross' death are at last revealed!

The Hulk is enlisted by a mysterious alien known as Qnax to help him retrieve a powerful machine - and whisked away to another world! Meanwhile, General Ross' dogged search for the Hulk continues as always, but he encounters a completely different gamma-powered beast than he expected!
If you can't beat 'em, join 'em, right? And if you won't join 'em, they'll force you to! Can the Hulk escape the clutches of the murderous Circus of Crime?
The Hulk's search for answers leads him to Las Vegas - straight into the arms of the Circus of Crime! Step right up, as the Hulk throws down with the Circus in the greatest show on Earth!
Super-villain weapons dealer Devlin DeAngelo has gotten his hands on a broken Super-Adaptoid, and he kidnaps the only man that can repair it - Bruce Banner!
The Hulk goes stealth! A new Hulkbuster base has closely guarded secrets that Hulk needs to find out - so it's time for Bruce Banner to sneak in!
A story ten years in the future! After the shocking events of last issue, ten years have passed, and the world has still not fully recovered- least of all the Hulk!
The unthinkable happens this issue! Someone closer to the Hulk than anyone else dies, and the life of both Hulk and Bruce Banner will never be the same.

Rick Jones has been paralyzed, and the Hulk wants to help his dearest friend. The Jade Giant embarks on a recruitment drive to get the three smartest men on Earth to help - Reed Richards, Tony Stark, and Bruce Banner himself!
Having let himself be captured by the Troyjans, Bruce Banner infiltrates their headquarters to learn their secrets!
Attack of the Troyjans! An army of robots is invading Earth, but how can the Hulk fight back when they've taken his friends hostage?
Bruce and Betty - reunited at last! The military - complacent with the Hulk! Is this a peaceful new beginning for Hulk? Or is there something sinister lurking in the shadows?
Bruce Banner comes face to face with the Hulk's oldest enemy - General Ross himself!
Witness the untold story of Bruce Banner's private war - in the depths of his own mind!

Rumble in the sewers! The Hulk has made it to New York, and all he wants to do is lay low and be left alone. But the Abomination has other plans! Watch the latest chapter in this monstrous rivalry unfold, as only one monster will walk away!

On the run once again, the Hulk stows away on a plane to New York. But having the Hulk in such a confined space so high up is NEVER a good idea! And the situation takes a turn for the worse when Mister Hyde makes his move!

The Hulk makes War! With his new power granted by Apocalypse, nothing seems capable of stopping Hulk in his tracks! To stop an unstoppable force, you need to find another unstoppable force! Enter the JUGGERNAUT!
The Hulk has been transformed...into the Horseman of Apocalypse, War! Can even the Hulk's oldest friend Rick Jones get through to him now?
He took on the Wolverine, and now the Hulk will face off with the rest of the X-Men! But what do the mutants want with the Hulk?

One of the Hulk's oldest and most storied rivalries comes bubbling back to the surface! On his way to the Savage Land, Hulk doesn't realize that he is being tracked...by none other than Wolverine! Get ready for a grudge match for the ages!
Only one thing can possibly break the Hulk's iron grip on Hulk Island...the Incredible Hulk! But why has this Hulk from the future approached the Hulk of today? Is he a friend or foe?

Welcome to HULK ISLAND! There are only two laws...1: Leave the Hulk alone, and you live. And 2: No one leaves Hulk Island! How will the government respond to the Hulk taking five thousand people hostage!?

Caught in a military trap, the Hulk has no choice but to escape to a nearby island! But this time, he's not just running away. Hulk cuts the island off from civilization, digs in his heels, and dares the military to try and take...HULK ISLAND!

Is the Hulk seeing double? It's business as usual for Hulk, locking horns with his nemesis Wildman, but things take a turn for the weird when the Incredible Hulk comes face to face with...the Incredible Hulk!?
Witness the introduction of the Thunderbolts, America's new premier superhero team! Can the Hulk withstand their assault? And why are they attacking the Jade Giant in the first place?
It's a new beginning for the Hulk! But new beginnings aren't always what old friends want, and Hulk finds himself at odds with his old teammates of the Pantheon!

The Hulk has emerged stronger than ever on the other side of his latest crisis - but with no memories! With Hulk not even recognizing those closest to him like Betty Ross, can anyone hope to subdue the rage within the Jade Giant?

The Hulk faces an old challenge with a new twist - the gamma radiation that powers him is leaking at a lethal rate! And with the military in hot pursuit, and his power draining, it seems his days are numbered. Is this at last the end of the Incredible Hulk?

Incredible Hulk vs. Onslaught! In this Incredible Hulk tie-in issue, the Hulk must team-up with the X-Men to take down their greatest telepathic foe. But will Hulk, in all his brawny might, still fall victim to the mind control of Onslaught? Plus, the fate of Rick Jones and Marlo Chandler revealed!
Storm gets involved in the fray between Cable and Hulk. Will the Weather Goddess' elemental powers prove puny in the presence of the almighty Hulk? An epic smack-down you have to see to believe!
The Hulk is back! And he's angrier than ever, having survived a point blank atomic bomb! But someone has come looking for him to ask for his help in saving the future - from the Hulk!
With the Hulk missing, it's time for the She-Hulk to take center stage! And she's already in hot water before long, as her and longtime Hulk ally Doc Samson come face to face with the Molecule Man!

The Incredible Hulk is no more! Is it really possible that the Hulk has finally been destroyed once and for all? And how do the ones closest to Bruce Banner cope with the news? A special issue starring Betty Ross and Jen Walters, the She-Hulk!
The Hulk is on a rampage of destruction unlike any he's ever committed before, and only the mighty Thor stands in his way!
The Hulk comes face to face with what may be his greatest enemy! But this showdown is unlike any he's ever faced before! For this enemy lives within his own mind - and is known only as THE MAESTRO!

Transforming back to the Hulk saves Banner from a deadly explosion, but with a stunning cost - reverting back into Banner's body will kill him! Only one mind on Earth can solve this crisis - one of Hulk's oldest foes, the Leader!
Trapped in the body of Savage Banner! It may be Bruce Banner's body, but it has the primal rampaging mind of the Incredible Hulk!
Hulk and Betty's escape into a quiet country life has been shattered! The military has discovered their location and has taken Betty captive! Can Hulk save her without succumbing to the rage within?
The Incredible Hulk vs. the Rampaging Rhino...in baseball? How in the world did this wacky sitaution come to pass?

In the aftermath of "OVER THE EDGE", one of Marvel's most enduring characters made the ultimate sacrifice. Now, Marvel's best and brightest pay their last respects to Nick Fury, agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. and the greatest spy who ever lived.

Hulk on the hunt! The Jade Giant is searching for a drug dealer with intel regarding Abomination, which means it's time for an investigation in the underbelly of New York City. But that turf already belongs to another crime-fighter - Frank Castle, better known as the Punisher!

A classic rivalry with an urban twist! The fight between Hulk and Abomination tears through the streets of New York, with no end in sight! Can the Hulk win without completely destroying Manhattan in the process?
A routine SWAT op goes sour when the troops stumble into the Abomination! There's only one thing that can solve this crisis - a big, green thing!
The Incredible Hulk has the strength, but does he have the speed to keep up with Speedfreek?

Hulk and Betty's peaceful getaway is turning into a not-so-peaceful thriller! Between hospital ambushes and clashes with superhuman police chiefs, can Hulk keep it together before Savage Banner takes over?
Hulk gets closer to discovering the secert of the missing children!

Hulk and Betty try to escape the whirlwind that has held up their lives lately, but the small town they run to has problems of its own! Someone has been kidnapping children, and Hulk aims to find out who!

When Bruce Banner's mind was able to finally control the Hulk, he never saw a reason to change back. But now the unthinkable has happened! How will Hulk's friend be able to contend with the strangest problem of all: SAVAGE BANNER?
Agamemnon's trial is cut short by the arrival of the mysterious Eternal Knights! Will their arrival mean the end of the Pantheon? And what is this startling new transformation for the Hulk?
The Trial of Agamemnon! The former ally of the Pantheon has been planting secret machinations for years, and now, all those secrets will come to life in a way that will change the Hulk forever!
The Incredible Hulk is dead! But even that won't stop him, as he begins a long and hard battle through the realm of Hel to return to the land of the living!

The search for Agamemnon continues! Hulk and his friends forge an alliance with old friends in Asgard. They're certainly going to need the extra help, considering they're headed to battle the Frost Giants of Jotunheim!
Hulk and the Pantheon begin their search for their mysterious friend Agamemnon! First stop: the realm eternal, Asgard!

There's no showdown in the universe that the Hulk can't smash his way out of. But there are some problems that even his great strength can't punch through, as Banner's old friend Jim Wilson experiences a shocking crisis.
The Hulk is ambushed by an unexpected foe - Talos, the mighty Skrull warrior! But what is Talos' reason for attacking the Hulk unprovoked - aside from the obvious death wish, of course!

Rick Jones, the Hulk's oldest (and for a long time, only) friend, is tying the knot with Marlo Chandler! But the wedding gets cut off by an unexpected guest - the devious Mephisto, who wants nothing less than Marlo's soul!

The Hulk has faced down some of the most dangerous beings in all of creation. He's survived cosmic events of cataclysmic proportions. He is, quite simply, the STRONGEST THERE IS. But now, the Hulk must somehow endure his most bizarre challenge yet - Rick Jones' bachelor party!?

Hulk, Surfer, and the Starjammers at last catch up with Trauma...and come face to face with his leader, the powerful Armageddon! But as far as Hulk is concerned, there's only two options for them: give up, or get smashed!

Stranded in space! Hulk and Silver Surfer have lost the trail of Trauma and Atalanta after a dizzying hyperspace jump! Good thing the noble space pirate crew known as the Starjammers arrives to lend a hand!

It's the Incredible Hulk - in space! Trauma has kidnapped Hulk's friend Atalanta, and intends to take her to the far reaches of the universe! Can even the aid of the Silver Surfer help Hulk make it in time?

Ambushed by Trauma! The old nemesis of Hulk's friends the Pantheon is out for revenge, and the Hulk is caught in the crossfire! Can Hulk and the Pantheon stop Trauma - without any casualties of their own?
The creature known as Bi-Beast has destructive plans for Earth, and only Hulk can stop him! And he's got help too - from his cousin Jen, the She-Hulk!

Hulk vs. S.H.I.E.L.D.! Both sides appear to be evenly matched, but the Hulk has a trump card up his sleeve. There's one thing Nick Fury can't resist - secret, shocking information, and the Hulk's got it!
Hulk is on a mission to rescue an old friend from captivity. There's only one problem - her captor is none other than Nick Fury, and her prison is none other than S.H.I.E.L.D.!
Madman, the King of England? Hulk must prevent his maniacal foe from carrying out a plot against Charles, Prince of Wales.
The battle rages on in Loch Ness, Scotland between the Hulk, Piecemeal and Madman! And Perseus gets caught in the crosshairs!
Hulk is shocked to find Piecemeal at the Lake of Loch Ness, instead of its fabled resident monster!
Captain America shows up to take Marlo Chandler into his custody, but a big green wall stands in his way! The Hulk and the leader of the Avengers brawl for the fate of Rick Jones' love!

Hulk's in the middle of a dangerous love triangle! When Ajax sees Achilles with Atalanta, you'd think Ajax's the one with the anger problem! Hulk must intervene before property damage, and broken hearts, ensue.
Under Mentallo's hypnosis, Hulk teams up with Juggernaut. The strongmen go head-to-head against Earth's Mightiest- but who's really bringing the might?

The Hulk has been defeated! Juggernaut's imprisoned him in Red Skull's hideout. And it only gets worse! Mentallo launches a psychic attack on Hulk, hypnotizing the not-so-jolly-giant to attack the Avengers!
Hulk inherits leadership of the Pantheon! His first mission? Travel to the Amazon rainforests where poisonous snakes aren't his worst threat. A strongman equal to the Hulk lies in wait!
The Leader has been blown to smithereens! In his place, a new villain must rise! Plus, Ironclad challenges the Hulk.
Hulk is informed of the Leader's whereabouts and makes his pursuit in a stampede of rage. But the Green Giant isn't the only one headed for the Leader! Hydra swoops in and only chaos is on the menu.

Marlo Chandler is dead! Rick Jones seeks aid from Doctor Strange, Reed Richards, and Henry Pym to save the woman he loves. Is there any chance for Marlo? Meanwhile, Hulk shakes his fists at Agamemnon for striking a deal with his nemesis, the incorrigible Leader!
It's the U-Foes and the Leader's goons versus Hulk and the Pantheon! While the fight wages on, a murderer stalks from afar!
Hulk and members of the Pantheon discover that the U-Foes have launched an attack! It's all-out battle between many powerful, irradiated foes! Enter the villainous mastermind, The Leader!
The Hulk, with the help of the Punisher, the Pantheon, and the police, avenge the death of Michael Berengetti!
Joe Fixit is back in Vegas- and back with a vengeance!

Hulk battles the powerful Trauma in an attempt to save Atalanta! Does Hulk have what it takes to stand up to this new enemy? Meanwhile, Rick Jones is confronted with some shocking news about his mother...
Igor Drenkov reveals his original plan to kill Bruce Banner with the G-Bomb test!
Kaos is strapped to an A-Bomb and only Hulk can save him!
Hulk goes toe-to-toe with X-Factor!
Hulk goes to town on a battalion of SHIELD robots!
Down in the Florida swamps, Hulk and Rick Jones discover two Man-Things- one good, one evil.
Bruce and Rick Jones learn a devastating secret about their friend Jim Wilson.
Max Meer has been injured and left to recover in a hospital. Meanwhile, Hulk and Sabra head to the Mount with the Pantheon. But is leaving young Max alone a wise idea...?

When Delphos prophesizes that a 10-year-old boy will become the next Hitler, Agamemnon of the Pantheon sets two missions in motion- Achilles is sent to Israel to kill the boy, while the Hulk is sent to save his life. Who will emerge victorious?
Back in New York City, things are out of control (more so than usual)! Hulk must team up with the Pantheon to defeat Gestalt, the villain responsible for the madness!
The Hulk has been shrunken down to six inches! Will this miniaturized Hulk be able to save Nadia Blonsky before the Abomination whisks her away to an unknown fate?
The Abomination kidnaps his ex-wife- and Hulk's not standing for it!
An unexpected friendship blossoms between the Hulk and Ajax. Betty Ross moves in with Marlo Chandler!
At the Pantheon's headquarters, Hulk dukes it out with the group's mightiest warrior...AJAX!
Vigilante Crazy Eight has been sentenced to death for the murder of a Senator! But only after her death does Doc Samson have a shocking revelation...
As the Hulk, Doc Samson and Ringmaster celebrate the successful merge of the Hulk personas, the trio is attacked by the Pantheon!
It's the most wonderful time of the year- for all but Rhino! What happens when the Gray Hulk bumps into the Rhino at a department store...where the villain is masquerading as Santa Claus?!

Bruce's mother convinces the conflicting Hulk personalities to merge within her son's mind. Meanwhile, Banner's lying unconscious in a hospital bed- and will remain there unless his alter egos reach an agreement!
Green Hulk vs. Gray Hulk! Who will win out and claim Bruce Banner?
The Gray Hulk, Betty and Rick Jones take on the Super-Skrull!
Newly reunited lovers Bruce and Betty set out looking for their friend, Rick Jones. Little do they know he's been captured by an all too familiar enemy...
Bruce and Betty rekindle their romance after finding humor in their mutual situations. All of this despite being trapped inside a convent...with Doc Samson's fleet barricaded outside!
Bruce finally tracks down Betty Ross...at a convent! Will the newly-avowed Betty realize her love for Bruce once more? Or will her holy obligations be the latest obstacle in their relationship?
Namor the Submariner and Doctor Strange are faced with the infernal Dark Hulk...a destructive being that's emerged from Banner's subconscious!
After Hulk saves Doctor Strange, the Sorcerer Supreme creates a mystical portal within Banner's mind- allowing Bruce to speak directly to the Hulk!
The Hulk comes face-to-face with the Freedom Force, a group of villains demanding his detainment. But a lot more is on the line than even Banner is aware.
Upon being ambushed by Doc Samson and company in Las Vegas, Hulk jumps aboard a moving freight train...where he encounters a shadowy figure.
Hulk finds the aptly-named Madman. Our hero must either face death in battle...or succumb to radiation poisoning!
The Leader has the cure for Hulk's deadly disease- in exchange for one small favor. Will Betty's whereabouts remain a mystery?
Powerhouse vs. Powerhouse! The Hulk goes head-to-head with the Fantastic Four's THING!
The tit for tat battle rages on between Hulk and the Abomination! And the Abomination will walk away from this one scarred- physically and mentally.
The Gray Gargoyle has just turned the Hulk into unmoving stone! Too bad no one told the Hulk!
The Hulk versus the Werewolf-By-Night!
The Hulk and Iron Man join forces to combat the Maggia.
The Hulk fights for Betty Ross' very soul!
Hulk comes face to face with Satan himself!
Hulk vs. the Necrophage: Round 2! Plus: Cloot's true identity revealed!
The Hulk takes on the Necrophage in Hell!
The Hulk takes a stroll through the streets of Vegas, looking for some trouble...
The Hulk has been trapped in a fantasy world where everything he imagines becomes real! Can Bruce Banner convince his alter ego to snap out of it?
Maggia's goons have been genetically enhanced, making it all the more interesting for the people betting on the fight against Mr. Fixit!
Mr. Maggia sends his goons to take out Michael Berenguetti. But Mr. Fixit is on site to sort the goons out!
The Wizard that snatched up the Hulk has dropped him in a magical land. Now the Hulk must put a stop to the Inquisitor!
After battling in the Evolutionary War, the Hulk takes a nap in his Las Vegas apartment. And the dream he has while he slumbers is no ordinary dream, but rather another adventure!
It's the Hulk versus The Thing versus...another Hulk? There's only one man who can be behind this: Doctor Doom!
Mr. Fixit and Spider-Man are having what you might call a communication breakdown. But then again, communicating was never one of Mr. Fixit's strong suits...
The Absorbing Man is hired to take down the gangster Berengetti and his bodyguard, Mr. Fixit!
Someone is trying to take down the biggest gangster in Las Vegas. And the gangster's body guard seems to have a lot in common with the currently missing Hulk!
Clay Quartermain, Rick Jones and Betty Banner explain the details of what happened to a jury. Meanwhile, S.H.I.E.L.D. soldiers find dust where the Hulk's body should be...
The Leader selects the small village of Middletown to detonate the gamma rays bomb he made Rock and Redentor steal from the government.
Rock and Redeemer attack the military facility that keeps the gamma rays bomb. Meanwhile, Betty Ross drops another kind of bomb on the Hulk...
The Leader lets Betty Ross go, but he sends 3 giant robots to escort her back to the Hulk. Smashing time!
With most of his energy sapped, Hulk must battle Half-Life!
The Hulk must defend his friends from the Savage Bull!

Here it is! Your #1 cover! And it looks like Wolverine and the Hulk are about to go at it again. Could it have ended any other way? These two have had so many epic brawls throughout the years they were bound to meet up again in the Top Covers competition. Todd McFarlane makes the fury palpable between the two sparring partners and heaven help anyone who gets in their way.
Bruce Banner, Rick Jones, and Clay Quartermain have made it to Boulder, Colorado when Clay decides to confront Banner about his past.
Bruce Banner, Rick Jones, and Clay Quartermain are on the run from SHIELD.
Gray Hulk and X-Factor reluctantly unite against the Hulkbusters! Guest-starring Doc Samson and the Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.!
Hulk comes into conflict with the heroic mutants of X-Factor! Will Marvel's Merry Mutants prevail? And why is Hulk...gray?
The Stalker is out doing what he does best, but the Hulk is out too, and he does things little bit better...
Bruce Banner and Rick Jones go on a city wide search to find Betty Ross...
Banner has made an important discovery about his transformation into the Hulk. So what does he do with this new information? Well, he goes drinking...
As a Hulkbuster is about to deliver the final blow to Rick Jones, someone steps in to save him!
While the Hulkbusters are trying to capture and kill Rick Jones, Clay Quartermain calls in a special request to the morgue.
A psychic villain has been attacking minds at the Gamma Base. An unlikely member of the team risks his life for Bruce.
Rick Jones seeks solace in Bruce Banner's old hideout. Can a Hulked-out Rick take on S.H.I.E.L.D. alone?
Bruce Banner is once again battling his greatest enemy- his own mind.
The Jade Giant battles the combined might of two deadly enemies! Can Hulk defeat Zzzax and the Rick Jones/Hulk hybrid? Or is it too much for one beast to bear?
It's the ultimate battle of Hulk vs. Hulk between Banner and Rick Jones!
Mysterious happenings persist at the Gamma Base after Bruce Banner is thought to be cured. Meanwhile, the Grey Hulk takes a hostage...
S.H.I.E.L.D. creates a genetic bath that will allow Bruce Banner to control the Hulk. But when the Hulk and Rick Jones are thrown in the bath by accident, a new Hulk emerges!
Complications arise when the Vision attempts to merge Bruce Banner's body with the Hulk's.
Two is better than one! Bruce Banner must merge back with the Hulk to save his life!
The Avengers and the Fantastic Four discover that the Hulk they are after is no longer connected to Bruce Banner- can they kill the beast given this new information?

Bruce and Betty's honeymoon is less than magical when Bruce suddenly collapses on their cruise ship! The Hulk inches closer and closer to New Mexico. Can Doc Samson and the Hulkbusters hold down the base with Banner out of office?
Speak now or forever hold your peace! When an unwanted guest crashes Bruce and Betty's wedding, Rick Jones intervenes. Will this interloper ruin the newlywed's big day?
Love is in the air for Bruce and Betty! Meanwhile, the battle rages on between the Hulkbusters and Doc Samson. The worst outcome imaginable comes to pass.
Things are turning around for Bruce Banner! Free from the grip of his alter ego, Bruce becomes the leader of the Hulkbusters...and asks Betty Ross a very important question!
While Bruce Banner lies helpless in a coma, the Hulk is on a rampage! Can the Avengers defeat the Green Goliath? Meanwhile, Doc Samson makes capturing the Hulk his personal vendetta...
Doc Samson discovers a way to separate Bruce Banner from the Hulk. But when Banner is rendered into a coma, will Samson's full plan come to fruition?
The Green Goliath receives a less-than-warm welcome upon his return to Earth! Can Hulk escape a confrontation with Doc Samson?
Hulk meets Walter Langkowski, who tells our hero that he's looking for a body to rest his soul. But is it the Hulk's body Walter's referring to?
The Triad reflects on Bruce Banner's life and realizes the important roles they've played throughout the years. Will these realizations help Bruce Banner become the Hulk's sole persona?
Bruce Banner finds himself in a messy situation with the woman he just saved...and the man she is about to slaughter!
The Hulk taps into Bruce Banner while saving a woman who is about to be sacrificed! But you know what happens when you interrupt one sacrifice...
The three facets of Hulk's personality try desperately to lead our hero to a better and safer place. But will Hulk listen to the Triad or follow his own path?
The Puffball pulls the wool over our hero's eyes! What will become of the friendship between Hulk and the Puffball once the Green Goliath discovers his "friend's" true intentions?
Can Hulk save his Puffball friend...and the dimension they've been dragged to?
Hulk refuses to join the crew of energy-eaters Klaatu, Captain Cybor and Xeron. But is Hulk's immense strength enough to ward off these diabolical menaces?
Hulk attacks the U-Foes with some surprising assistance. Meanwhile, what will the Senate say when Doc Strange informs them of Ol' Greenskin's whereabouts?
Things go awry when Hulk tries to find his next meal. Plus, the U-Foes escape!
Our hero is powerless as a slave to the Red Knights! A certain viridian vixen may be able to help Hulk out of this bind...
Hulk leaves Crossroads and enters a dimension where a beautiful, green-skinned woman cries tears that transform into flowers. Does Ol' Greenskin have a shot with this mystical lady?
Exiled to the Crossroads Dimension, the Hulk comes across the Puffball Collective. Doctor Strange is a close onlooker.
Hulk's blind anger and rage have entirely replaced Banner's humanity. Marvel's finest heroes assemble to take down the Hulk...but their efforts prove futile.
Doctor Strange proves to be Bruce Banner’s final shot at salvation.
Hulk takes on Doctor Strange’s nemesis, Nightmare!
Hulk continues to regress into a savage state. Which hero will rise to the occasion to help Banner undergo a heroic transformation?
Bruce Banner vs. a Hulked-out Max Hammer!
When Hulk returns from the Beyonder's Secret Wars, he discovers that Max Stryker has been using the Gammascope treatment on many people, regardless of knowing any of its long term side effects…
Cancer-ridden crime lord Max Stryker forces Bruce Banner to use the Gammascope treatment on him!
After the Hulk is shot at in an airport, he rebuilds his assailant’s hometown which Banner destroyed accidentally as the Hulk.
Bruce Banner is transformed into the Hulk unwillingly while under Ringmaster’s mind control!
Bruce Banner stops by the Marvel office for advice on how to handle General Ross!
M.O.D.O.K. transforms Kate Waynesboro into Ms. M.O.D.O.K., his new bride!
Kate reveals herself to be an Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D.!
M.O.D.O.K. and General Ross strike a deal that results in the Abomination destroying the Hulk!
When Bruce Banner gets chummy with his new research assistant, Dr. Kate Waynesboro, Banner's Recordasphere gets extremely jealous and sets out to destroy the friendship!
Hulk is transported into the 41st century by "The Hero"!
Zzzax is reborn when Stark Industries accidentally installs the wrong equipment in Banner and Lang’s lab!
The Hulk travels through time to help save the Avengers!
The Avengers, the Hulk and She-Hulk are fooled by the Leader at his space station, where he sends the Avengers hurdling through time!
It’s a warm family welcome when She-Hulk assures her cousin Bruce that she is happy as the Green Giantess. Later, the Avengers Mansion is attacked by the Leader!
Hulk fights a long, fierce battle against the Humanoids when he refuses the Leader’s proposal to join him as a world leader.
Bruce’s date night with Bereet is interrupted by journalists and Leader's Humanoids!
The Hulk is finally given a hero’s treatment!
President Ronald Reagan grants the Hulk Amnesty!
The U-Foes are going to make an example of the Hulk…by executing him on international TV!
Just as Bruce gets his Hulk powers under control, the U-Foes appear!
Jackdaw steals fighter robot Megalith from the Gamma Base!
Hulk goes through bullets and grenades just to get “home” to Betty and Rick.
Bruce realizes how dangerous the Hulk power can be when he destroys an alien seed supply that could’ve possibly ended world hunger…
Bruce Banner makes new discoveries about his Hulk powers while fighting Wendigo! Sasquatch of Alpha Flight guest-stars.
The Hulk finds himself on Halfworld, a strange planet full of talking animals.
Hulk vanishes while battling the Galaxy Master! Later, Betty Ross saves Rick Jones’ life…
Daydra, Empress of the Sagittarius System, recruits Hulk to take on the Galaxy Master!
A cursed spirit begins purging Bruce Banner of the Gamma rays that hold him prisoner in his own body. Will the price of freedom outweigh the price of morality?
Glorian turns a town of people against Hulk by disguising its citizens as Hulk's greatest enemies!
Everything's gone bananas in the New Mexico desert! All humans in the area have turned into apes- including Betty and Rick!
Rick Jones and the Rangers team up to save a hypnotized Hulk!
None
Los Angeles faces the rumblings of Avalanche and Landslide! Can Hulk find his footing against these quake-inducing foes?
Bruce spends a month with the beautiful Glazier at her glass home in Malibu. But will Hulk's dreams shatter when Glazier takes their friendship to the next level?
Bruce Banner is met by an old foe upon his arrival at Easter Island- the Absorbing Man attacks!
Banner vs. Talbot reaches a climactic head when Talbot attacks Hulk atop a Japanese volcano!
Banner teams up with the Russian Super Soldiers to thwart Phobos' plan. Can Phobos be stopped before the whole world suffers Chernobyl's fate?
Hulk finds himself in the radioactive "Forbidden Zone" in Russia, just as the Russian Super Soldiers arrive! A coincidental battle ensues!
Bruce Banner begins his journey with two Arabs who believe they have uncovered a thousand year old myth!
Hulk finds himself in the crossfire of the Israelis and the Arabs! Will Banner's compassion for a fallen child soften Sabra's heart?
Hulk vs. Thor in a battle across New York City! Banner decides to embark on a long journey.
Hulk accidentally foils the plan of four villains attempting to have a Fantastic Four-like transformation.
Civil War breaks out amongst the Changelings! Will Hulk's peers accept his help in their direst hour?
The Changelings have kidnapped Betty Ross and Rick Jones! Can Hulk retrieve his friends, or will his efforts be unwelcome once again?
The Gamma Base crew must aid a wounded centaur that's arrived at their cabin's doorstep. And from there...things only get stranger!
Just as Bruce warms up to a beautiful woman, Silver Surfer confronts our hero with a plan to stop Galactus!
Unlike Frosty, Jack Frost isn't such a jolly, happy soul! He's decided to unleash his minions to attack Hulk...and Doc Samson and General Ross' cabin will be caught in the crossfire!
Hulk is attacked by the Gardener...who has claimed K'ai's lush terrain for himself! Can our hero and the citizens of K'ai avenge Jarella's death by restoring their homeland to its former glory?
Hulk and the citizens of K'ai mourn the loss of Queen Jarella.
In a failed attempt to help the Hulk, Captain Marvel accidentally shrinks the Green Goliath to subatomic size!
Hulk is ambushed at the Gamma Base by Glenn Talbot...who has military orders to kill the Hulk! Will Hulk be slain before he can rescue the body of his love, Jarella?
While in Los Angeles, the Hulk is suddenly attacked! Will the Green Goliath destroy the Living Colossus and finally get some much-deserved downtime?
Hulk believes all is well when he defeats Tyrannus and goes off to save Jarella! But Hulk has caused destruction in the golden city of El Dorado, and now the Gamma Base is in hot pursuit!
Hulk and the Goldbug go head-to-head with Tyrannus! Will our hero and his ally be defeated once more, failing the people of El Dorado?
Tyrannus rises from the life force of the Hulk! Do Hulk and the Goldbug stand a chance?
Hulk and the Goldbug enter the secret, golden city of El Dorado! Meanwhile, Bruce is attacked in an attempt to save Jarella.
The Goldbug pulls the wool over Hulk's eyes! And by the time the Green Goliath realizes he's been tricked...it's already too late!
The President and Clay Quartermain watch in horror as Hulk rampages through Central City, California. An alien threat enables a plan against Hulk.
Is the Machine Man friend or foe? At last, Hulk's long awaited reunion with Trish Starr!
Catastrophe ensues from Hulk's battle with Machine Man. Meanwhile, Trish Starr remains at large.
Hulk and Fred Sloan race against the clock to recover Trish Starr. Is the Machine Man truly behind her kidnapping?
The hospitable Trish Starr has been kidnapped by one of Jackson's goons- Machine Man, no less! Her fate may be sealed if Hulk is unable to help.
Hulk lets Curtiss Jackson get away- but at the cost of saving another! Will Hulk join Marvel Man on his mission to re-capture Jackson?
The Hulk is imprisoned at Alcatraz- alongside Captain America, Falcon, and Marvel Man! Can these four powerhouses break free from their bonds and save Jim Wilson?
The Hulk is tricked into making friends, as Jim Wilson is tricked into finding the Hulk. With both bamboozled, what will become of the Gamma Base?
A traitor at the Gamma Base is causing the devastating breakdown of General Ross. Plus, Hulk has an (unexpected) extraterrestrial adventure!
The Hulk is provoked and attacked by Moonstone! But this villainess is also Dr. Karla Sofen, an esteemed associate of Doc Samson. Moonstone's origin revealed!
None
Doc Samson makes a psychiatric breakthrough and discovers that Banner and the Hulk are two separate beings! Will Doc be able to crack the conundrum of Hulk's split psyche?
Banner faces an identity crisis when trying to reconcile his two halves. Only one man can help Bruce- Doc Samson, PhD!
Doc Samson revives the dying body of Bruce Banner...by reawakening the Hulk!
The Leader has seized the Gamma Base and taken its entire team hostage. But Bruce Banner has an idea- he'll use a Hulk robot to take out the villain! What could possibly go wrong?
Just as Bruce is freed from the Hulk's curse, trouble arises at the Gamma Base. The Leader returns- and imprisons Colonel Ross and Doc Samson!
Bruce Banner is rescued by radioactive children. But little does he know...the children are cannibals- and he's on the menu!
Bruce Banner is in for a surprise when he's stowed away on the ship of- The Stingray!
Captain Barracuda has captured Hulk and Crusoe, and the pirate has turned Crusoe into an ape! Can Hulk stop this piratical menace before he himself is turned into a gorilla?
Tension on the high seas! Hulk is on a deserted island...where his ship is attacked by Captain Barracuda!
Doc Samson and The Rhino exchange blows when Rhino unleashes terror on public transportation. But will Samson be able to subdue his foe without the help of his allies?
writer: Keith Pollard, Len Wein, Roger Stern

issue_description: Hulk befriends a group of ex-circus performers. Will this be a clan the Green Goliath can call his own?
Hulk battles the Bi-Beast! And the stakes have never been higher!
The Hulk is taken unawares when apprehended by S.H.I.E.L.D.! What mysterious force is wreaking havoc inside the S.H.I.E.L.D. chopper?
How is Jack of Hearts different from the rest of Hulk's foes? And what's setting off Hulk's murderous rage this time?
The Hulk battles the Quintronic Man with help from his pal Jim Wilson! Will these two neutralize the robotic menace?
Can the Hulk save his friend Jim Wilson from the Constrictor? Meanwhile, Betty is gone in a flash- but has a new look and a new life!
None
The Hulk is trapped in a mind game as he does battle with Maha Yogi and Doctor Druid!
Hulk battles the Absorbing Man...on the first day of his new job! In New Mexico, it's splitsville for Betty and Glenn Talbot. What went wrong?
Just as Bruce Banner starts a new life for himself in New York, the Absorbing Man returns to defeat the Hulk! Doc Samson finds a suspicious individual at the Gamma Base.
Hulk says his final goodbye to Jarella. Will this tragedy spiral the Green Goliath out of control?
The Hulk is in dire need of Doctor Strange's mystical expertise. But all does not go as planned when Ol' Greenskin arrives in Manhattan- will Jarella find salvation?
Tragedy clouds the love between Hulk and Jarella. Will Doctor Strange use his mystic might to prevent Jarella's certain death?
The Hulk's love, Jarella, has been captured and quarantined! And you think you've seen the Hulk mad before…
Ol' Greenskin is finally extracted from Glenn Talbot's mind. Will the wedding of Jarella and Hulk come to fruition?
Hulk is sent to an all-green world where he is reunited with his love Jarella! Is this finally Hulk's happily ever after?
Trapped within Glenn Talbot's mind, the Hulk continues to shrink down to molecular levels! Could he possibly shrink into nonexistence? But first, a visit to Terragonia!
None
Doc Samson and S.H.I.E.L.D. embark for Florida to retrieve the Hulk. Betty is tormented with guilt over her passion with Doc Samson.

The Hulk is aboard The Collector's ship where the villain has mutants and humanoids on display in his own personal museum. Will Hulk free the "exhibits"...or be tempted by The Collector's cure for Banner's condition?
The Collector is on the hunt, and he's looking to add the Hulk to his collection! And he's got a green giant of his own the battle the Hulk for dominance - the mysterious Man-Thing!
The Hulk and the Abomination join forces and take over a Florida space station! 'Nuff said!

The Hulk takes a young orphan to the Wonderland Amusement Park in Florida...where they are met by the Abomination! What will Doc Samson, General Ross, and Clay Quartermain do when two monsters seek revenge?
The Hulk meets a young couple, but is soon attacked by the bride's father- The Locust! At the Hulkbuster base, Doc Samson and General Ross put their plans for the Hulk in motion.
Dr. Leonard Samson, PhD, is a victim in a gamma ray explosion. Introducing...Doc Samson!
The Hulk has a Scottish adventure when he battles the fabled Loch Ness monster!
Torkon II, leader of the Toadmen, wants a fantasy world just like the Hulk's! And he'll stop at nothing to achieve Utopia!
Glorian and the Shaper of Worlds bestow a gift upon Hulk- a perfect, paradisiac world! Betty confronts the tragic reality that her husband Glenn is brain-dead.
Hulk must save a serum that will restore the sight of a little Russian girl. But will the Mole Man and his Moloids foil Hulk's mission?
It's a mad rush to defeat the Gremlin and get out of Bitterfrost- S.H.I.E.L.D. has timed the fortress to explode!
It is revealed that Glenn Talbot is being held captive at a Soviet base in Siberia! Can General Ross, S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Nick Fury and Clay Quartermain save Talbot...without Bruce Banner's help?
Hulk is incapacitated in a deprivation tank! Meanwhile, Hulkbuster scientist Captain Kirkman turns out to not only be a Russian spy...but The Devastator!
A visit from President Gerald Ford turns ugly when Armbruster's suspicions about Glenn Talbot are confirmed! Betty is conflicted when a battle breaks out between her father and the Hulk.
The Hulk must battle...his own shadow? Meanwhile, more shady business unravels at the Hulkbuster Base in New Mexico.

Bruce lands a job as a scientist in Chicago! When an experiment goes awry, Zzzax is summoned, absorbing the intellect and feelings of scientist Stan Landers. Will Bruce choose his new life over saving the city of Chicago?
Hulk befriends homeless man Crackerjack Jackson in the wilds of Canada. What will happen when Jackson is reunited with his long lost son, Johnny Anvil?
The first appearance of Wolverine! And he throws down in one of Marvel's greatest battles with the Incredible Hulk!
While in Canada, Hulk is lured into an occult ritual conducted by Marie Cartier. Will Marie use Hulk's body as the host for an evil spirit?
Bruce winds up in the Appalachian Mountains where he meets Lincoln, a radioactive monstrosity. And Lincoln's radioactivity is killing the rest of his town!

Hulk is reverted back to Bruce Banner by an act of brute force. Banner can only watch in horror as the Counter-Earth battle rages on in D.C. Who is the madman posturing as President of Counter-Earth? And will Hulk be able to save his friend Adam Warlock from certain execution?
Hulk believes he is in Washington D.C., but actually finds himself on Counter-Earth! Will Hulk be able to survive on a parallel planet so different from his own?

Following his destruction of the Inhumans' home, Hulk is launched into the vastness of space. Not realizing he is onboard a space shuttle, Hulk smashes "free", and nearly pilots himself, and the crew, into the sun!
Bruce Banner is hurled to Attilan where he is greeted by the Inhumans. But when provoked into becoming the Hulk, the Inhumans realize why some things are better left on Earth!
Trouble down under! The Cobalt Man is destroying Sydney with his nuclear powers! Can Betty and Ted free Bruce from his tranquilized captivity?
Hulk becomes a stowaway on Ralph Robert's ship on a mission to test an H-bomb. The Cobalt Man reveals himself to the X-Men.
In an attempt to send Hulk into a space-time warp, Dr. Corbeau releases the Juggernaut from his interstellar exile...and places him in the same cage as the Green Goliath!
The Hulkbuster base has been captured by Abomination and the Rhino, and the villains have Jack Armbruster, Colonel Ross and Betty as their captives!
Will Hulk be able to save Betty from the wrath of volcano monsters? The Green Goliath and his lady love are trapped on an island...an island crawling with creatures beyond any conceivable nightmare!
Will the Harpy triumph over Hulk? If Betty Ross isn't reverted to her former self soon, she may inadvertently kill the man she loves! Plus, attack of the Bi-Beast!

The rise of the Harpy! Betty Ross gets a dose of gamma radiation...transforming her into a vengeful monster intent on Hulk's destruction! Will Hulk be able to save Betty from herself, or will the Harpy sink her talons in first?

This is it! The long-awaited reunion between Bruce and Betty. Betty's mourning the recent death of her husband, Glenn Talbot. But why is she blaming the Hulk for his demise? M.O.D.O.K. lays the groundwork for his next, sinister plot...all contingent on Betty!

A rescue mission extracts General Ross from his Russian captors- but will Glenn Talbot now take Ross' place? Hulk successfully reaches New York's shores...and must immediately help Hawkeye with the ever-shocking Zzzax!
Hulk's been shanghaied into Captain Omen's crew, but will he wriggle his way free? If Hulk doesn't get himself out of this bind quickly, he could forever remain on the ocean floor!

Where General Ross is in hot water with the Russians, the Hulk is in cold water- literally! While trying to cross the Arctic Ocean, Hulk requires an assist from one Captain Omen. But is Omen as benevolent as he seems?

General 'Thunderbolt' Ross and Hulk, captives of the Gremlin! Kidnapped by the Russians, Bruce Banner and Ross have no choice but to forge an alliance. But where Banner agrees to cooperate...the Hulk refuses!
Hulk's wandering in the Canadian wilderness hits a snag when he encounters a legendary creature...with an intense bloodlust. Tremble at the mythic Wendigo!

Still riled by Betty's marriage, Hulk pays a not-so-friendly visit to Canada. Will Beast of the X-Men be able to talk, (or smack) some sense into Ol' Greenskin? And will Beast be able to keep his true appearance secret from Vera Cantor?
The Hulk mindlessly trails Betty Ross, in the vain hope that Banner can make amends with his lost love. But when Hulk does reach Niagara Falls, a bigger problem lies in wait- enter Tiger Shark!
The Hulk is back on earth at last! But so is...the ever-awesome Abomination! It's a serious slugfest.

Rhino becomes the ultimate wedding crasher- at the nuptials of Betty Ross and Glenn Talbot! Plus, the Leader's master plan careens Hulk and Rhino towards Counter-Earth. Will the two combatants remain trapped on this faraway planet?
The Rhino returns, but he's not the one calling the shots! Bruce laments his loss with Betty Ross, as Betty prepares to wed Glenn Talbot. Plus, what's the Leader up to?
It's Hulk vs. Hulk- to the death! But one of our green-skinned goliaths has the brain of...Bruce Banner?

Enter the awesome entity called the Shaper of Worlds! All of reality is threatened by this latest foe. And if that weren't enough, a Nazi war criminal makes his villainous debut: introducing Captain Axis!
The astonishing Ant-Man guest-stars! Plus, the Chameleon and the many hordes of Hydra! Hulk shrinks to a subatomic level to find Jarella...but what does this mean for Betty Ross?
The Hulk on trial! And Matt Murdock's for the defense! Plus, check out a handful of guest-witnesses- all faces you've seen before!
The Hulk- captured and held for trial! And the lawyer's name is...Matt Murdock! Sound familiar?

They call it the Crawling Unknown! And it's the one thing so loathsome, so mind-shattering, that even ol' Greenskin can't stop it! Plus, will Bruce Banner find a way to be reunited with his true love, Jarella?
The return of the X-Man Havok! The magnetic might of Polaris! Plus, Hulk goes on a rampage, just as the military closes in.

He is called The Inheritor. And what he claims as his birthright is nothing less than...planet earth! Will Hulk be able to subdue this empowered adversary? Plus, learn of The Inheritor's strange beginnings!
At last! The Hulk finds Jarella, the girl from the emerald atom! But what's the difference, for tomorrow...the Sun dies!
Androids replace our nation's leaders- for the deadliest purpose of all! The Hulk must right everyone else's wrongs. Plus, is this the end of the road for Doc Samson?
The Leader makes a triumphant return with his wildest, most macabre scheme of all! And what can Greenskin do- especially with the world up in arms against him?
From a star beyond a star comes a power-mad Colossus! The Hulk must do battle as he never has before! But can even he hold out for long against...Godspawn?
It's Hulk's fight-to-the-finish with Dr. Doom! And this issue packs the wallop of a gamma-bomb blast! Will Latervia be spared once the dust settles?
This is it! Hulk finally meets Doctor Doom! But will these two titans clash in deadly battle...or team up to conquer mankind? Don't miss the shocking story arc, "Sanctuary"!
Who would believe it? A fundraising party for the Hulk! Plus, the sensational return of the vengeful Valkyrie! And when these two meet it really packs a punch!
Bruce Banner is the Hulk no more! But what could make him risk his very life to become once again the green-skinned man-monster? Nothing except...Doc Samson!

The Hulk has been teleported away to the far-off island of the Psyclops. The Psyclops are an ancient insectoid race that has been living off the radar. Will the Avengers be able to save the Hulk from his own rage against the aliens?

Marvel's Not-So-Jolly Giant vs. Just About Everybody! The Leader. Sandman. The Abomination. The sensational Sub-Mariner...and a host of others! What has brought all of Hulk's foes out of the woodwork? With a final page worth waiting for.
Once more, the Hulk takes on the super-powered Sandman- and this time it's for keeps! Plus, the shocking fate of Betty Ross! What health crisis is threatening her life?
The conclusion to the most far-out Hulk saga of all! And...the long-awaited fight-to-the-finish between Hulk and the awesome Abomination!
From beyond time and space comes the behemoth Klaatu- and the one they call Xeron the Star-Slayer! Who are these creatures dispatched to destroy the Hulk?
Once again, Kang strikes from the far future - and this time his weapon is the Hulk himself! With the most unexpected guest-star yet!
The Golem walks among us! And wait till you learn his amazing true identity! A mythical masterpiece that has Hulk up to his ears in trouble.
The Hulk battles the legions of the power-crazed dictator called Draxon. And he's alone in a far-flung clime!
Hydra's back- and they've got ol' Greenskin! But can they hold him? Find out in a most cataclysmic climax!
A titan amidst the tenements! And all that stands between the rampaging Hulk and a helpless Bruce Banner is...Iron Man! This one's a must!
At the end of his rope, Bruce Banner seeks a cure for his gamma radiation...with disastrous results. Now, the Hulk and Banner are two separate entities- with two very different agendas!
Our green-skinned goliath fights for his life against the unstoppable, revenge-crazed Glob! It's the rematch you've been waiting for!
It had to happen! The Gamma-Green Giant takes on the mighty Avengers. And in the middle of the San Andreas Fault, too! Will Earth's Mightiest be enough against the rage of the Hulk?
From dim, dark caverns beneath the earth comes...Mogol the Mighty! Strong enough to defeat the Hulk- or to help Hulk destroy the world!
The Hulk is trapped in the occultist plot of a crazed cult! Will the Undying Ones be unleashed once more? But first, the Night-Crawler emerges. Doctor Strange guest-stars!
The Absorbing Man is back- and the Hulk's got him nailed! Or...is it the other way around? The answer'll rock ya!
Will Bruce Banner and Betty Ross get married? The Rhino says "No!"...and so does the revenge-crazed Leader!
The Leader is back- and out for vengeance! And if he can't find the Hulk, then Bruce Banner will do! A thriller of a read delivered by Marvel legends Roy Thomas and Herb Trimpe!
The rematch that had to happen! Ol' Greenskin takes on the entire Fantastic Four- and how!
He's like nothing you've ever seen before- the swamp-born Glob! Hulk takes on his slimiest foe yet!
The green-skinned giant takes on the U.S. army- with Maximus at his back!
Once again, the green-skinned rampager must face the murderous might of Maximus and his band of evil Inhumans! If action is your dish, this one's a feast!
Hulk battles the sensational Sub-Mariner! What more need we say- except to tell you that Stan 'The Man' and 'Happy' Herbie Trimpe bought a dozen each themselves!
The Hulk's final confrontation with the Leader! But will Hulk's efforts be enough to avert WWIII? Don't miss this (literally) explosive issue!

The Eve of Annihilation...at the hands of the Leader! More eager than ever to eliminate the Hulk, the Leader builds an android whose only function is to neutralize Bruce Banner. But will the Leader's 'super-humanoid' also usher in WWIII?
The Hulk is trapped at General Ross' Gamma Base! With no escape in sight, and the Leader as persuasive as ever, is this Hulk's stickiest predicament yet?

The Mandarin and Sandman are aligned against Hulk! With the oncoming evil multiplied, can the Gamma Green Giant withstand the storm? Especially when Betty Ross is used as a pawn in the Mandarin's game?

Bruce Banner's in deep trouble! Hurtling through space in a capsule without oxygen, Banner's life is measured down to mere moments. But will Bruce's scientific ingenuity be his saving grace? Plus, Hulk takes on Sandman!
Hulk vs. the Galaxy Master! Hulk enters into galactic warfare with an overlord of an alien race.
Bruce Banner lies dying in the Savage Land, with only Ka-Zar and Zabu as allies...until a strange alien race kidnaps and revives the Hulk! Enter the Galaxy Master!
The showdown in the Savage Land comes to a head! The evil Umbu is determined to let the artifact wreak havoc on Earth's rotation, and the only thing left that can stop it is the Incredible Hulk!

Stranded in the Savage Land! Between dodging dinosaurs, Bruce Banner must race to find a dangerous artifact that threatens Earth's axis. And since it's a Savage Land story, it wouldn't be complete without saying: guest-starring Ka-Zar!
The menace of the Mandarin continues! What is his secret plan, and how does it involve the Hulk? You won't want to miss this explosive climax!
Hulk vs. Mandarin! The Jade Giant is transported to the secret lair of the diabolical despot, and is immediately thrown into the deadliest gauntlet he's ever faced!

The super-slugfest between the Hulk and the Missing Link continues! But the battle takes a startling turn when the pair of behemoths are captured mid-battle by Yuri Brevlov and his team of Soviet spies!
The Hulk throws down with a mysterious creature known only as the Missing Link! What is the origin of this Cro-Magnon menace? And what exactly are Rick Jones and Glenn Talbot up to during all this?
Bruce Banner - prisoner of the USA! But even being held by the government can't help Bruce when he's abducted by the Rhino!

Just as Betty is about reveal her feelings to Bruce, The Space Parasite reveals himself! Bruce is forced to transform into the Hulk, leading to an all-out brawl at Yankee Stadium! And even if the Hulk wins this battle, Bruce may lose more than he ever imagined...
When Loki transports the Hulk to Asgard, the Warriors Three rush to meet the Jade Giant!
If the Hulk can't handle the Metal Master, it could mean the end of the human race!
More powerful! More dangerous! More uncontrollable than ever before! Here comes The Hulk! See the Hulk rage in "Beauty and the Beast!"
The Incredible Hulk in two feature length thrills: "The Monster and the Machine" and "Mongu! Gladiator From Space!"
See the Hulk banished to outer space, trapped by the Ringmaster, and other thrills with the everyone's favorite Jade Giant!
The Incredible Hulk in "The Terror of the Toad Men!"
Is he a man, monster or both? The jury is still out on that one, but fans have decided that this cover by Jack Kirby is one of Marvel's best!
HULK: UNITED concludes, as Hulk squares off against Doombots!
HULK: UNITED rages on! Hulk wants a piece of Doom but first he's got to get through the Mad Squad!
HULK: UNITED begins! Clues to Banner's master plan are revealed and the return of Dr. Doom means a monumental day of reckoning for Hulk and Banner!
Hulk vs. Wolverine! Hulk vs. Thing! The conclusion of STAY ANGRY! What devious plan has Banner been up to?
A lost city of Sasquatches! Featuring the world's deadliest hunter, Kraven!
Hulk's rage must remain unbound in STAY ANGRY in order to prevent the now-psychotic Bruce Banner from re-emerging.
Hulk continues to STAY ANGRY! To do so, the green goliath picks some fights,on the ocean floor and in space!!! Sea monsters! Russian Super-Soldiers! The angriest Hulk yet!

In order to stay himself, Hulk must stay angry! Attempting to keep his rage levels high, Hulk challenges The Punisher to a battle that will prove to be the one of the deadliest fights Hulk will ever face!
With the search on to find Bruce Banner, Red She-Hulk may be the only hero who knows how to track him down. How did she learn this information, and will she actually use it to help find Banner?
It's Hulk versus Banner in the epic conclusion to their bloody encounter. The world isn't big enough for the two of them...

What dark price did Hulk pay to separate himself from Banner, and how far will he go to keep it that way? Hulk vs. Banner's newest, maddest creations -The Banner Men! The biggest, nastiest Hulk Vs. Banner fight in Marvel History!
The mysterious figure who split Banner and Hulk is revealed.
The fight everyone's been waiting for: Hulk vs. Banner! Plus, Banner unleashes an army of Hulked-out monsters!

Bruce Banner's beasts "The Boar Brothers" bash Hulk in a literally Earth-Shaking Battle!
Banner reveals his new army!
Hulk makes an alliance with mad scientist hunter AmandaVon Doom that changes his destiny forever.
The Hulk and Bruce Banner are now separate entities but still at odds with one another. The Hulk has been assigned to take Banner down...but Bruce isn't going without a fight.
Whatever happened to Bruce Banner.? RED SHE-HULK knows, and is NONE TOO PLEASED.

THE MONSTER'S END! The curse of the Hulk has turned into a horror, and now Amadeus enters his final showdown with the monster within. But what happens if the monster...turns out to be Amadeus himself? A hero faces his greatest demons with the lives of everyone he loves in the balance and massive repercussions for Amadeus and the Hulk!

WORLD WAR HULK II CONTINUES! Amadeus Cho has always thought of himself as the fun Hulk - the totally awesome Hulk. But now the Dark Hulk within him is calling the shots with brutal consequences for anyone who's ever wronged Amadeus or stood in his way. Get ready for Amadeus unleashed and cataclysmic smashing in the heart of New York as our hero - and the world - finally learns just what the curse of the Hulk is all about.

WORLD WAR HULK II CONTINUES! Out of the trunk and off the chain, the dark aspects of Amadeus' personality run unchecked as the Hulk displays his awesome power before the Champions, Alpha Flight, the Black Panther and the world! Can anything bring the Formerly Awesome Hulk to heel before disaster strikes?!

WORLD WAR HULK II BEGINS! Following his apocalyptic adventure on Planet Hulk, Amadeus Cho returns to Earth - but the raging monster inside of him has been unchained, leading to dire consequences for anybody who crosses the Formerly Awesome Hulk's path!

RETURN TO PLANET HULK PART 5 HULK has reached the final level of THE GAUNTLET! The freedom of the DOKA'ABI CLAN rests on his shoulders alone…Who is the true WORLD BREAKER? With AMADEUS refusing to embrace the DARK HULK within, it's up to the Warlord of Sakaar to show him real brutality…Guest-starring THE UNWORTHY THOR!

RETURN TO PLANET HULK Part 4. The Hulk enters the next stage of barbaric trials known as the Gauntlet…Amadeus must do the unthinkable to save the people of Sakaar…But if the Dark Hulk within him is finally loose, who will save Amadeus from himself?

RETURN TO PLANET HULK Part 3! On the savage planet of Sakaar, the last remaining tribes of a dead society fight for dwindling resources… A sequence of ancient trials known as the Gauntlet is the only way to survive! A champion is called to battle: AMADEUS CHO, THE TOTALLY AWESOME HULK! His opponent is a familiar one… WITNESS THE THUNDERING BARBARIAN!!! The ODINSON!

RETURN TO PLANET HULK Part 2. Stranded on Sakaar, Amadeus Cho must embrace the savage Hulk within himself if he's to survive the barbaric planet... But who sent the mysterious call for help that brought him to this deadly planet? Can Cho conquer a series of impossible trials known as THE GAUNTLET, or will it conquer him?

RETURN TO PLANET HULK Part 1 When Amadeus Cho picks up a distress signal from a distant planet he's shocked to find out it's from SAKAAR. As the Totally Awesome Hulk, he's been trying to avert the curse of anger that haunted Bruce Banner. But SAKAAR is a place for warriors and gladiators…a place where the Hulk fought brutally in the Imperial Arena…who is calling Cho for help? PLUS: Includes 3 bonus MARVEL PRIMER PAGES! Story by Robbie Thompson and a TBA artist!

issue_title: Hulk Visionaries: John Byrne Vol. 1 (Trade Paperback)
issue_description:
When the Hulk came back from the Crossroads, John Byrne was waiting for him - complementing his popular X-Men and FF runs by literally breaking the Green Goliath in two! After the Hulk and Bruce Banner are separated, the Jade Giant becomes the Earth's emerald enemy - outfighting Iron Man, Wonder Man, Sub-Mariner, Hercules and Doc Samson! Could the one to succeed where these powerhouses failed be...Bruce Banner himself?! Plus: the wedding of Bruce Banner and Betty Ross! The new Hulkbusters! And the sinister Scourge! Collecting INCREDIBLE HULK #314-319 AND ANNUAL #14, and MARVEL FANFARE #29.
Rated T+ ...$24.99
ISBN: 978-0-7851-2705-5

issue_title: Hulk Visionaries: Peter David Vol. 5 (Trade Paperback)
issue_description: Collects Incredible Hulk #364-372 and Annual #16. The latest collection for David devotees starts off with a crisis countdown that takes the gray Hulk from one fight to another against the Abomination, the Fantastic Four and a Madman who can't decide if he's Bruce Banner's biggest fan or worst enemy! Then, it's a reunion with Doctor Strange and Namor the Sub-Mariner when the Hulk joins his fellow founding Defenders against an invasion from a universe even stranger than they are! Plus: the fate of Betty Brant Banner! Also featuring Mister Hyde and the mutants of Freedom Force!

issue_title: Marvel Masterworks: The Incredible Hulk Vol. 4 (Hardcover)
issue_description: Collects Incredible Hulk (1968) #103-110 and Annual #1. It's time for more Masterworks mayhem from the house-shakin' Hulk! Now headlining his very own title again for the first time in six years, the Green Goliath has twice the space to shake the Earth with his mighty rage, and you can bet Mighty Marvel is going to take advantage of every square inch of that space! See the beginnings of the Hulk's first outer-space adventure versus the Space Parasite! Place your bets for the strongest man-monster in the Marvel U.-ol' Greenskin or the Rhino! Then it's road-trip time! The mighty Hulk travels continents far and wide, and believe it or not, he doesn't make too many friends along the way! It's a travelogue of destruction that's going to leave the Mandarin, the Inhumans, and the entire Savage Land rubbing a sore jaw in the wake of a freight train named "Banner." Guest-starring Nick Fury and Ka-Zar!
